gated.title: Mystery Cults and Initiation
gated.intro: Mystery Cults, Initiation Scripts, Ordeals and Quests.

entries.title: Mystery Virtues Taught to Non-Initiates
entries.summary: Explains that Mystery Virtues, unlike intrinsic magical gifts, can be taught to the uninitiated under special circumstances, and what the cults do to those who leak their secrets.
quotes: This usually requires a Minor Breakthrough

entries.title: Lexicon of the Mysteries
entries.summary: Glossary of the terms used for Mystery Cult play, including Cabal Legacy, Common Magics, Initiation Script, Mystagogue, Probationer and School.
quotes: Initiation Script: A document that sets out the rites, teachings, and prerequisites for Initiation, used by a Mystagogue to conduct an Initiation.

entries.title: Entering a Mystery Cult
entries.summary: Describes the three ways a magus is drawn into a cult, the probationer stage, the season spent learning (Mystery Cult) Lore, and what Initiation grants (a Mystery Virtue plus possible Ordeal Flaws that cannot be undone).
quotes: attaining a score of 1 or more in the Ability (Mystery Cult) Lore
Thus magic cannot undo Initiation effects.

entries.title: Revised Ability: (Mystery Cult) Lore
entries.summary: Defines (Mystery Cult) Lore as the Organization Lore of a particular cult, covering its rites, signals and ceremonies, and says how experience in it is gained and how it can fragment a cult.
quotes: (Mystery Cult) Lore is the (Organization) Lore of a particular cult.

entries.title: (Mystery Cult) Lore and Degrees of Initiation
entries.summary: Gives the usual (Mystery Cult) Lore scores required for a first Initiation, later Initiations and the inner circle of a cult.
quotes: A score of 6 is normally required for Initiation to the inner circle

entries.title: Quests, Ordeals, and Sacrifices
entries.summary: Explains the three prices of Initiation: Ordeals that inflict a permanent Flaw but ease later Initiations, Quests that are always stories taking at least a season, and Sacrifices of time, wealth or items.
quotes: All Initiation Quests take at least one season.

entries.title: Distractions and the Initiate
entries.summary: Special rule for what happens when an Initiation season is interrupted by distractions, which can make the Initiation fail.
quotes: for each month lost to distractions, reduce the Initiation Total by one-third of its original amount (rounding fractions up)

entries.title: Time and Initiation
entries.summary: States that an Initiation, including any Ordeal, takes an entire season in which no other activity is possible, and that the probationer needs a level of (Mystery Cult) Lore first.
quotes: the Initiation (including associated Ordeals) itself requires an entire season

entries.title: Time and the Mystagogue
entries.summary: Says how much of the Mystagogue's own time an Initiation costs, normally a short distraction unless he is teaching a Supernatural Ability.
quotes: generally amounts to a seven-day distraction for the Mystagogue

entries.title: The Mechanics of Initiation
entries.summary: Introduces the principle that Mystery progress gives more gain than loss with no fixed ratio, measured in stories and seasons, and that Hermetic Flaws can be taken as Sacrifices of power.
quotes: progress in a Mystery Cult depicts an increase in power, with more gain than loss, and no fixed ratio

entries.title: The Mystagogue
entries.summary: Describes the Mystagogue as a role (not a title) held by whoever conducts an Initiation, who must have the best (Mystery Cult) Lore and a higher degree than the Initiate; Presence makes leading Initiations easier.
quotes: A high Presence makes leading Initiations easier

entries.title: Virtues Initiated
entries.summary: Says which Virtues can be gained by Initiation and how Initiation lets Supernatural Abilities be learned without the usual study penalty, reaching level 1 after a season with a teacher.
quotes: Mystery Cults can avoid the penalties described there through Initiation rituals and Ordeals

entries.title: Initiation Rites
entries.summary: The core Initiation procedure: the Mystagogue's Initiation Total has no die roll and must exceed a Target Level that depends on whether the Virtue is Major or Minor, whether the Mystagogue knows it, and any previous Ordeal.
quotes: Initiation Total: Presence + (Mystery Cult) Lore + Script Bonus
To Initiate a Minor Virtue known by the Mystagogue, the Target Level is 15
There is a minimum Target Level of 9 no matter how great a reduction is applied.

entries.title: Example Initiation Script Designs
entries.summary: Notes on applying Scripts to non-player characters and how previous Ordeals usually make up the shortfall for Major Virtues.
quotes: Note that the process of Initiation relies upon the Mystagogue's Presence + (Mystery Cult) Lore, not the Initiate's.

entries.title: Example: Darius Undergoes Initiation
entries.summary: A worked example of a probationer's first two Initiations showing the Initiation Total, Target Level changes, Script bonuses and Ordeal reductions in play.
quotes: His Initiation Total before the Script bonus is, therefore, a respectable 10.

entries.title: Modifying the Initiation Script
entries.summary: A Mystagogue can vary an existing Script with a roll against an Ease Factor that depends on whether a component is added, changed or removed, with only one change attempted per Initiation and a failed change leaving the original Script usable.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + (Mystery Cult) Lore vs. Ease Factor
The Ease Factor is 9 to extend the Script by adding a new component
The Ease Factor is 15 to remove a component from the Script, reducing the Script bonus.

entries.title: Experimental Scripts
entries.summary: Procedure for a Mystagogue with no adequate Script to experiment on a new one: choose a Risk level, roll on the Extraordinary Results chart, check the rite's validity, receive a sympathy bonus, then compare the Initiation Total with the Target Level.
quotes: Roll a Stress Die + Risk Modifier on the Extraordinary Results chart on ArM5, page 109.
Roll a Simple Die + Risk Modifier + Intelligence + (Mystery Cult) Lore vs. Ease Factor of (9 + Proposed Bonus)
Presence + (Mystery Cult) Lore + Revised Script Bonus + Risk Modifier

entries.title: Simplified Mystery Cult Initiation
entries.requires: Mystery cult membership; fallback if the troupe lacks Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults or The Mysteries: Revised Edition
entries.summary: Gives a quick approximation of Mystery Cult Initiation for troupes without the full rules: the Mystagogue assigns a year-long Quest, the Initiate suffers an Ordeal and gains a Virtue, guided by an Initiation Script.
quotes: During the Quest, the Initiate undergoes an Ordeal (gains a Flaw) and comes to a higher understanding of the Mystery (gains a Virtue).
The instructions for an Initiation are contained in a special Laboratory Text called an Initiation Script.

entries.title: Character Creation and the Mysteries
entries.requires: Starting a magus already Initiated into a Mystery cult (storyguide permission)
entries.summary: Rules for starting a magus who already holds House Mystery Virtues: they use ordinary Virtue and Flaw slots, and for older characters an Initiation costs the experience of one lab season. Includes the sidebar of common Script element bonuses.
quotes: subtracts 10 experience points from the character's total

entries.title: The Initiated Apprentice And Beyond
entries.requires: Parens belonging to a Mystery Cult, with troupe permission
entries.summary: Rules for starting characters who are already Initiates, and for advancing a magus through Initiations as background experience (one season per Quest plus one for the Initiation itself), including how to sketch a Script quickly.
quotes: The whole process takes one full season per Quest, and one for the Initiation itself.
each season of Initiation or Questing means the character loses 10 experience points from the yearly 30

entries.title: Experimenting To Discover a New Minor Virtue Script
entries.summary: Worked example of a Mystagogue experimenting to create a new Script (risk modifier, validity roll, sympathy bonus, Initiation Total) and a later Mystagogue extending it.
quotes: Her player rolls Intelligence +3 and Seventh Wave Lore 6 vs. an Ease Factor of 9 (to add a component).

entries.title: Cabal Legacy — Minor Hermetic Story Flaw
entries.summary: The Story Flaw that lets a new magus begin play already Initiated, taking cult Virtues and Ordeal Flaws as part of the normal ten points of Virtues and Flaws.
quotes: It allows a magus character to be designed with cult Virtues as normal Virtues, part of the standard ten Virtues and Flaws

entries.title: Responsibilities of Membership
entries.summary: Guidelines on duties, annual vis dues and time commitments that a cult can demand of its Initiates and how to balance them against character progression.
quotes: A single pawn of vis a year is a reasonable symbolic requirement
A donation of perhaps seven or more pawns of vis seems appropriate for Initiation into a new degree.

entries.title: Progression in a Mystery Cult
entries.summary: Rule of thumb for how quickly characters should gain Initiations in slow, medium and fast sagas, measured in stories more than years.
quotes: the figure of three years per Initiation provides a reasonable rule of thumb

entries.title: Inventing Your Own Cult
entries.summary: How player characters can found a new Mystery Cult: the storyguide creates a new (Mystery Cult) Lore, characters study it, and one of them eventually experiments to produce the first Initiation Script.
quotes: the storyguide to create a new (Mystery Cult) Lore for the new cult

entries.title: Mysteries
entries.summary: Introduces mysteries as paths to greater power needing sacrifices; characters in the four Mystery Cult Houses are Initiated into the Outer Mystery as apprentices and seek deeper mysteries in play.
quotes: Player characters in the Mystery Cult Houses are Initiated into the Outer Mystery as apprentices, but must seek Initiation into deeper mysteries in play.

entries.title: Mystery Initiation
entries.requires: Initiation into a Mystery cult (House Lore)
entries.summary: Summary of how a Mystagogue's Initiation Total is compared with a Target Level (no die roll), including Target Levels, the effect of earlier Ordeals, and the minimum.
quotes: INITIATION TOTAL: Presence + (House) Lore + Script bonus
To Initiate a Minor Virtue known by the Mystagogue, the target level is 15
To Initiate a Major Virtue known by the Mystagogue, the target level is 21

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition, Chapter 2: Entering the Mysteries

alsoIn.title: Mystery Initiation: Initiation Total and Target Levels

entries.title: The Initiation Script
entries.requires: Initiation into a Mystery cult (House Lore)
entries.summary: A written text describing a successful Initiation, whose price may be an Ordeal, a Quest or a Sacrifice, and whose bonuses contribute to the Initiation Total if followed exactly.

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition, Chapter 2: Entering the Mysteries

versions.title: The Initiation Script
versions.summary: Lists the components of an Initiation Script and the bonus each adds to the Initiation Total (travel, Quests, Ordeals, Sacrifices, Mystagogue's time, sympathetic bonus), with three sample Scripts and the rules for when a bonus is invalid.
quotes: +9: The Initiate suffers a Major Ordeal inflicting a specific Major Flaw during the Initiation.
+3: The Initiate has to complete a specified Quest.

entries.title: Example Elements of an Initiation Script
entries.requires: Initiation into a Mystery cult (House Lore)
entries.summary: Table of common Script bonuses for special place and time, Quests, sacrifices and Ordeals of varying severity.
quotes: Initiate has to complete a specific Quest

alsoIn.title: Example Elements of an Initiation Script

entries.title: Varying a Script
entries.requires: Initiation into a Mystery cult (House Lore)
entries.summary: A Mystagogue may modify an Initiation Script with a test against an Ease Factor depending on whether a component is added or changed; only one change per Initiation is allowed.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + (House) Lore vs. Ease Factor

gated.title: Curious common magics
gated.intro: Lesser Mystery Virtues known widely: Potent Magic, Performance Magic and more.

entries.title: Potent Magic
entries.summary: Reproduces the Potent Magic Hermetic Virtue, which gives a bonus in a narrow field like a Magical Focus and lets the magus design Potent spells. Several mysteries in this book rely on it.
quotes: grants a +3 bonus to Lab Totals and Casting Scores
grants a +6 bonus to Lab Totals and Casting Scores

related.text: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material Bonus table

entries.title: Potent Magic — Minor or Major Hermetic Virtue
entries.summary: Gives a narrow-field (Minor) or wide-field (Major) bonus to Lab Totals and Casting Score and the ability to invent Potent spells; compatible with a Magical Focus and can be taken more than once for different areas.
quotes: Minor Potent Magic covers the same narrow fields as a Minor Magical Focus, and grants a +3 bonus to Lab Totals and Casting Score.
Major Potent Magic covers the same wide fields as a Major Magical Focus, and grants a +6 bonus to Lab Totals and Casting Score.

entries.title: Potent Spells (Potency)
entries.requires: Virtue: Potent Magic (to design); any magus may learn one
entries.summary: Defines Potency as the sum of Shape and Material bonuses of the Casting Items built into a spell, added to the Casting Score; Potency is capped by Magic Theory and the caster must touch the Casting Items.
quotes: Potency Score = Sum of Bonus from each Casting Item
Potency Bonus: Add Potency to Casting Score
a magus may not invent a Potent spell with a Potency higher than his Magic Theory score

related.text: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material Bonuses

versions.title: Potent Spells
versions.requires: Virtue: Potent Magic to design; any magus may learn and cast one
versions.summary: A Potent spell has a Potency bonus built from Casting Items that the caster must touch, added to the Casting Score. Potency is part of the spell design and travels with Lab Texts and teaching.
quotes: Potency = Sum of bonus from each Casting Item
Potency Bonus: Add Potency to Casting Score
related: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material Bonus table

entries.title: Initiation into Major Potent Magic
entries.summary: Major Potent Magic is normally Initiated as a progression that replaces Minor Potent Magic, making the loss an Ordeal.
quotes: Major Potent Magic may be (and normally is) Initiated as a progression from a Minor Potent Magic

entries.title: Potent Magic and Potent Spells
entries.summary: How a Potent Magic magus designs new Potent spells or variants with different Casting Items, as if from a Lab Text, and writes Lab Texts for them.
quotes: The total Potency may not exceed the magus's Magic Theory.

alsoIn.title: Potent Magic and Potent Spells (Inventing and Varying)

entries.title: Designing Covenant Libraries
entries.summary: At covenant creation, Potency counts toward a Potent spell's level when spending Build Points on Lab Texts.
quotes: add Potency (if any) to spell level when counting Build Points

entries.title: Performance Magic, In Brief
entries.summary: Abbreviated rules for the Performance Magic Virtue: disguising spellcasting with a performed Ability, recognizing the Form of such a spell, and a new Performance Duration for spells.
quotes: Recognize Form of Performance Magic Spell: stress die + Perception + Awareness + effect magnitude vs. Ease Factor 15
Cast a Performance Duration Spell: die roll + Ability's Characteristic + Ability vs. Ease Factor 3

entries.title: Performance Magic — Minor Hermetic Virtue
entries.summary: Lets a magus replace Hermetic words and gestures with the actions or words of a chosen mundane Ability, concealing spellcasting; covers which Abilities can be chosen and how normal casting adjustments still apply to components not replaced.
quotes: You may not choose any Language, Supernatural, Academic, or Arcane Ability.
Words or gestures that are not being replaced by Performance Magic remain as normal mystical components of spellcasting

entries.title: Performance Abilities
entries.summary: Lists which Abilities qualify for Performance Magic and the special stress die with extra botch dice needed to use a martial Ability while in combat.
quotes: the player rolls a stress die with three extra botch dice, and treats all non-botches as die rolls of zero

entries.title: Sorcerous Music (Performance Magic)
entries.summary: Special rules for Performance Magic (Music): song or an instrument can replace gestures and/or words, and Voice Range carries as far as the music can be heard.
quotes: cannot be performed silently

entries.title: Recognizing Performance Magic
entries.summary: Gives the Ease Factor adjustments for other magi trying to determine the Form of a spell cast with mundane words or gestures.
quotes: Stress Die + Perception + Awareness vs. 15 – effect magnitude
–3 if Hermetic words are spoken (and can be heard)
+3 if both words and gestures are mundane

entries.title: New Duration for Performance Magic
entries.summary: Defines the Performance Duration, equivalent to Concentration, and the roll needed to start a spell with it; no further Concentration rolls are needed while the performance continues.
quotes: Performance is equivalent to Concentration Duration.
Characteristic (varies with Ability) + Ability against an Ease Factor of 3.

entries.title: New Summon and Command Spells
entries.summary: New Rego guidelines for controlling or summoning disembodied spirits by their own Form, plus the rule that Mentem or Animal spells can command spirits with Intelligence or Cunning.
quotes: Level 5: Control a disembodied spirit of (Form)
Level 15: Summon a disembodied spirit of (Form)

entries.title: Spell Binding — Minor Hermetic Virtue
entries.summary: Explains how a spell is bound into a physical container with a general Ritual spell so a trapped lesser spirit sustains it indefinitely, including what spells can be bound and how the container spell is timed.
quotes: The spell to be sustained cannot be a Ritual spell, nor have a duration of Momentary.
The base level of this container ritual must equal or exceed the spell to be sustained.

entries.title: Suitable Spirits
entries.summary: Which spirits can be bound to sustain a spell: disembodied spirits with sufficient Might, thematically linked to the spell and of the same realm as the magus's magic.
quotes: must have a Might at least equal to the level of the spell to be sustained

entries.title: Spirit, Spell and Container Combined
entries.summary: What a bound spirit can and cannot do, how the spell fails if the container is broken or the spirit's Might drops, and the level of spell needed to command the spirit out.
quotes: If the spirit's Might falls below the level of the spell, the sustained spell fails
Such a spell must have a level that exceeds the level of the container spell that binds both the spell and spirit

entries.title: Planetary Magic — Minor Hermetic Virtue
entries.summary: Lets a magus build a Laboratory Horoscope for a planet and gain an Astrological Modifier to the Lab Total when creating an enchanted device, by rolling against an Ease Factor tied to the desired bonus.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence +Artes Liberales (Astronomy) vs. Three Times the Desired Bonus
Only one planet, and thus one bonus, may be invoked for any given season of work on an enchantment.

entries.title: Distractions from Planetary Magic
entries.summary: How lost laboratory time affects an Astrological Modifier: missing a whole day cancels the bonus.
quotes: she loses the benefit of the Astrological Modifier if she is ever forced to miss a whole day away from the laboratory

entries.title: Lab Texts and Planetary Magic
entries.summary: A Lab Text never carries an Astrological Modifier; any later season using it needs a fresh Laboratory Horoscope.
quotes: must create a new Laboratory Horoscope using Planetary Magic

entries.title: New Shape and Material Bonuses
entries.summary: Table of additional Shape and Material Bonuses from alchemical discoveries that any magus may use, particularly for Potent spells and Hermetic Alchemy.
quotes: These shapes and materials are based on the discoveries of alchemists, but can be used by any magus.

related.text: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material Bonuses

entries.title: Vulgar Alchemy — Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue
entries.summary: Introduces Vulgar Alchemy, which lets a magus experiment with new components during enchantment to discover personal Shape and Material Bonuses; it cannot be used on invested devices but works for charged and lesser enchanted devices.
quotes: Vulgar Alchemy is not usable on invested devices

entries.title: Vulgar Alchemy: the experiment
entries.summary: How to begin a Vulgar Alchemy enchantment season: choose components up to the limit of Magic Theory, complete the enchantment and determine the Experimentation Bonus.
quotes: The magus may choose any number of components up to the limit of his Magic Theory score
Experimentation Bonus = Simple Die roll + Risk Modifier

entries.title: Repeated Experiments to Determine a Category
entries.summary: Suggested formula for how many successful tests a component needs to establish a bonus covering a broader category, by scope.
quotes: 3 x proposed bonus score, plus a scope factor:
+15 if the scope is a single Hermetic Technique

entries.title: Testing the Components
entries.summary: How the Experimentation Bonus is divided among components, with a Perception + Magic Lore roll for each untested component against an Ease Factor based on the proposed bonus.
quotes: Simple Die + Perception + Magic Lore vs. an Ease Factor of 3 + (3 x proposed Material or Shape Bonus)

entries.title: Vulgar Alchemy: the final result
entries.summary: The Vulgar Alchemy Lab Total for the experimental enchantment and for repeating it without experimentation, and what a Lab Text conveys to others.
quotes: Intelligence + Magic Theory + Technique + Form + Aura + Magic Lore + Experimentation Bonus + Successful Component Bonuses
Intelligence + Magic Theory + Technique + Form + Aura + Magic Lore + Component Bonuses

entries.title: Vulgar Alchemy: the bonuses
entries.summary: How discovered bonuses stay personal, can be widened into categories, and can be taught to others by a Magic Theory tractatus whose Quality meets twice the Bonus Level.
quotes: He may do this provided his Quality (Com + 6 + bonuses) for writing the book is at least twice the Bonus Level.

entries.title: Withstand Casting — Minor Hermetic Virtue
entries.summary: Reduces the Fatigue lost when casting by one level per level of the Virtue (never below one level lost), with the reduced loss keeping the same short-term or long-term character as normal.
quotes: he loses 1 less Fatigue level than normal, with a minimum of 1 Fatigue level
withstand 1 Fatigue level for each level of the Virtue

entries.title: Withstand Casting and Vulnerable Casting
entries.requires: Virtue: Withstand Casting / Flaw: Vulnerable Casting
entries.summary: A character cannot start with both, but may acquire both in play; the extra loss from Vulnerability is applied first and then withstood.
quotes: You may not start your character with both Vulnerable Casting and Withstand Casting.
apply the extra loss from Vulnerability first, then withstand the increased loss

entries.title: Life Boost and Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic
entries.requires: Virtue: Withstand Casting with Life Boost or Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic
entries.summary: Explains how Withstand Casting interacts with Virtues that pay for extra spell power with Fatigue: withstanding those levels removes the boost they paid for.
quotes: if he does then he loses the benefits from withstood levels

entries.title: Astrological Magical Focus and Potent Magic
entries.requires: Virtue: Magical Focus or Potent Magic (astrological)
entries.summary: Allows a Magical Focus or Potent Magic to be defined by a single astrological sign, planet or house; spells that use such a benefit count as Astrological spells.
quotes: Any magus may have a Major Magical Focus or Major Potent Magic covering effects governed by a single astrological sign.

entries.title: Initiating Magic for Birth Sign, Planet, or House
entries.requires: Initiation: astrological Potent Magic or Focus
entries.summary: Relaxes the rule that the Mystagogue must know the Virtue when the Initiate's birth sign, planet or house matches, and gives sympathy bonuses or penalties for matching, other or opposed signs.
quotes: magi Initiating into the magic of their birth have a +1 sympathy bonus for Initiation
causes a penalty of –3

entries.title: Astrological Cyclic Magic — Minor Hermetic Virtue or Flaw
entries.summary: Lets Cyclic Magic follow astrological cycles of the zodiac, raising the bonus or penalty when the cycle covers less of the year.
quotes: The bonus or penalty is increased to 5.
The bonus or penalty is increased to 6.

entries.title: (Astrological) Mutable Virtue or Flaw
entries.summary: Lets a Virtue or Flaw apply only in the four mutable signs: Major ones drop to Minor, Minor ones are doubled in intensity.
quotes: the Virtue or Flaw is reduced to being Minor
the effect is doubled in intensity

entries.title: New Mastery Ability — Ceremonial Casting
entries.requires: Mastery Ability: Ceremonial Casting (Cult of Mercury)
entries.summary: A spell mastery option letting a magus apply the Ceremonial Casting rules to a specific spell that is not already a Ritual using them.
quotes: The maga may apply the rules for Ceremonial Casting (ArM5, page 83) to casting this spell.

entries.title: Longevity Ritual Vis Limits
entries.summary: Vis needed to design a Longevity Ritual and the much lighter limits when rebrewing a dose from its Lab Text.
quotes: the enchantment requires one pawn of vis for every five years of age (rounded up)

entries.title: Hermetic Alchemy — Hermetic Minor Virtue
entries.summary: Overview of the Virtue that lets a magus extract more vis, or Form-specific vis, in the laboratory.
quotes: Hermetic Alchemy lets the magus extract more vis from an aura, or to extract Form-specific vis rather than Vim vis.

entries.title: Improved Extraction of Vis
entries.summary: Lab Total for extracting vis using a crafted receptacle with Shape and Material Bonuses, and the number of pawns of Vim vis yielded.
quotes: Alchemical Vis Extraction Lab Total = Creo + Vim + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura Modifier + Shape and Material Bonuses
Vim Vis Extracted = one-tenth (round up) of Vis Extraction Lab Total

entries.title: Form-Specific Vis
entries.summary: Extracting Form-specific vis rather than Vim vis halves the yield, uses a Form requisite for the Creo Vim Lab Total, and cannot produce Technique vis.
quotes: Form-specific Vis Extraction Lab Total = Creo + Vim (Form requisite) + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura Modifier + Shape and Material Bonuses
Form Vis Extracted = one-twentieth (round up) of Vis Extraction Lab Total

entries.title: Choosing Appropriate Shape and Material Factors
entries.summary: How to pick which Shape and Material Bonuses apply to a vis extraction by imagining a single invested effect of the desired Form, with the total bonus capped by Magic Theory.
quotes: but the total Shape and Material Bonus is limited by the magus's Magic Theory score

entries.title: Philosophic Alchemy — Minor and Major Mystery Virtue
entries.summary: Lets an alchemical object digest on its own so vis is extracted (or ready-opened enchantment spaces created) with little attention; the Minor Virtue needs a year and the Major Virtue a single season.
quotes: Minor Philosophic Alchemy requires a year (four continuous seasons) of fermentation and digestion
Major Philosophic Alchemy allows a more efficient digestion to be established, which is completed in a single season.

entries.title: Automatic Extraction of Vis
entries.summary: A settled extraction counts as a seven-day distraction from other lab work, may run alongside other lab activities, and is ruined if distractions exceed 20 days.
quotes: treating the vis extraction as a seven-day distraction from other lab work
if the distractions exceed 20 days, the digestion is spoiled and must be abandoned

entries.title: Time Needed for Automatic Extraction of Vis
entries.summary: Minor Philosophic Alchemy runs for four seasons and the vis extracted is based on the lowest of the four Lab Totals; only one extraction can run per season and experimentation spoils it.
quotes: the vis extracted is determined by the lowest of the four Lab Totals
A magus may only manage a single vis extraction in any season

entries.title: Ready-Opened Devices
entries.summary: Philosophic Alchemy can instead produce a device with already-opened enchantment spaces, equal in number to the pawns of Vim vis that would have been extracted.
quotes: The number of spaces open is equal to the number of pawns of Vim vis that would have been extracted into it as automatic vis extraction.

entries.title: The Lesser Elixir — Minor Mystery Virtue
entries.summary: Introduces the Lesser Elixir, a personal formula that improves the aging bonus of a Longevity Ritual by adding special ingredients; it cannot be made for another.
quotes: The Lesser Elixir increases the aging bonus of a Longevity Ritual by incorporating additional ingredients.
The Lesser Elixir requires Hermetic Alchemy.

entries.title: Creating the Lesser Elixir
entries.summary: Procedure for inventing a Lesser Elixir: perform the Longevity Ritual, spend a season adding an ingredient, and derive the Elixir Level from Elixir Points (capped by Magic Theory) to add to the Aging Bonus.
quotes: Elixir Points = Total of Points from Extra Ingredients
Aging Bonus = Longevity Ritual Modifier + Elixir Level

entries.title: Elixir Points
entries.summary: How ingredients earn Elixir Points from the Shape and Material Bonuses table; personally discovered items count double, but no single item may exceed the magus's Magic Theory.
quotes: No single item may have a bonus exceeding the alchemist's Magic Theory score.

entries.title: Repeating the Lesser Elixir
entries.summary: After an Aging Crisis the Lesser Elixir must be repeated on top of a fresh Longevity Ritual, and it may be reinvented with more ingredients for a further season.
quotes: If the magus suffers an Aging Crisis, the Lesser Elixir loses its effectiveness, and must be repeated.

entries.title: The Great Elixir — Major Mystery Virtue
entries.requires: Virtue: Great Elixir (requires Unaging and Lesser Elixir)
entries.summary: Introduces the ritual by which an alchemist becomes an immortal being of Magic by creating and consuming a Great Elixir.
quotes: The magus must have both the Virtues Unaging and the Lesser Elixir.

entries.title: Preparing the Great Elixir
entries.summary: How the Great Elixir device is prepared, the enchantment spaces it takes, and the two unique Mystery effects (Become a Being of Magic, Grant Might) invested in it.
quotes: The Lesser Elixir uses up (Longevity Ritual level/10) enchantment spaces in the Great Elixir device.
the magus gains Magic Might equal to half (effect level–20)

entries.title: Testing the Great Elixir
entries.summary: Roll made when the maga drinks the potion; failure means a new dose and attempt, with Lab Text and cumulative bonuses to later attempts.
quotes: Simple Die + Stamina + Lesser Elixir Level + Reroll Bonus vs. Ease Factor of (Age/10, round up)
each attempt at the Great Elixir grants a cumulative +1 bonus to the roll, to a limit of the maga's Magic Theory

entries.title: Success! Effects of the Elixir
entries.summary: A successful Great Elixir permanently turns the magus into an immortal alchemical being of the Magic realm with a Might score from the potion.
quotes: He may be slain, but he will not die of lesser wounds, nor age or Warping.

entries.title: Improving the Elixir after Transformation
entries.summary: An immortal magus can brew a new Great Elixir to raise his Might; the Ease Factor stays fixed at the age at transformation and the cumulative bonus resets.
quotes: The Ease Factor to test the potion remains fixed at the age when the magus transformed

entries.title: Structure of the Order of the Green Cockerel
entries.requires: Mystery Cult: Order of the Green Cockerel
entries.summary: The seven degrees of the Green Cockerel and the Virtue Initiated at each (Planetary Magic, Vulgar Alchemy, Unaging, Hermetic Alchemy, Lesser Elixir, Philosophic Alchemy, Great Elixir), with degree-specific requirements.
quotes: creating at least seven new Shape and Material Bonuses before progressing to the next degree of Initiation

entries.title: Spells to Determine Astrological Time
entries.summary: New Intellego Vim guidelines for measuring astrological time and conditions, used with Astrological Durations; they need no astrological Virtue.
quotes: Discern and measure a single astrological factor in the environment.
Discern and measure all astrological factors in the environment.

entries.title: New Shape and Material Bonuses
entries.summary: Shape and Material Bonuses for an armillary sphere and an astrolabe.
quotes: Armillary Sphere: +5 display the heavens, celestial time

entries.title: Appendix: Astrological Correspondences
entries.summary: Reference for astrological correspondences, including how to cast a Daily Horoscope or Nativity Horoscope with an Intelligence + Astronomy roll against Ease Factor 9.
quotes: Creating a Daily Horoscope takes one hour.
Creating a Nativity Horoscope takes a day's work.

entries.title: Signs by Category
entries.summary: Table giving each zodiac sign's element, humor, gender and temperament (cardinal, fixed, mutable).

entries.title: Signs and Decans
entries.summary: Table of the influence of each of the three decans of every zodiac sign.

entries.title: Astrological Houses
entries.summary: Table of the twelve astrological houses and the province each governs.

entries.title: Spheres of Influence of the Planets
entries.summary: Table of what each planet influences and which Characteristic it governs.
quotes: Influences rulership, kings, leadership, and authority, health, and well-being, and governs the characteristics Presence and Stamina.

entries.title: The 12 Astrological Houses
entries.summary: Explains the ascendant sign and how the circle of the Zodiac is mapped into twelve houses that shape how each sign influences the world.
quotes: The sign is known as the ascendant, and is the starting point of the horoscope.

entries.title: Periapt — Minor Mystery Virtue
entries.summary: Lets a magus create a seasonal Periapt Horoscope that acts as a single-use Lab Text for making astrological charged devices.
quotes: the charges resulting equal those that the magus would produce if he already had a Lab Text for the enchantment

entries.title: Creating a Periapt
entries.summary: Requirements for a Periapt Horoscope, the number of charges produced and the maximum Effect level, which depends on Artes Liberales (Astronomy).
quotes: Number of charges = Lab Total / 5 (rounded up)
Maximum Effect level = 5 x Artes Liberales (Astronomy) score

entries.title: Creating a Periapt Horoscope
entries.summary: The roll to prepare a seasonal Periapt Horoscope on an equinox or solstice, with failure and botch consequences for the whole season.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Celestial Magic — Major Mystery Virtue
entries.summary: Introduces the Major astrological Virtue that includes and replaces Planetary Magic and adds wider Horoscopes, astrological Durations, a favorable hour for casting and astrologically linked enchantments.
quotes: This Virtue includes and replaces the benefits of Planetary Magic, which is a required prerequisite.

entries.title: Improved Laboratory Horoscopes
entries.summary: Celestial Magic lets the Laboratory Horoscope bonus apply to any laboratory activity, and also reduces the vis needed to open an invested device.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. Three Times the Desired Bonus
subtract the Laboratory Horoscope bonus for the opening season from the number of pawns of vis required to open the device (minimum of one pawn)

entries.title: Astrological Durations
entries.summary: Defines the astrological units of time (Minute, Hour, Day, Sign) that Celestial Magic can use for spell Durations and says an Astronomy roll is required.
quotes: An Astrological Minute for spells is the same as a Hermetic Diameter Duration
Using Astrological Durations requires a roll of Astronomy.

entries.title: Limits on the Use of Astrological Time
entries.summary: Astrological conditions are only uniform within about 500 paces of the point of measurement, which limits the area and Target Size of astrological spells.
quotes: conditions are essentially identical over an area extending approximately 500 paces in all directions from the point of measurement

entries.title: New Duration: Minutes = Diameter
entries.summary: The four astrological Durations (Minutes=Diameter, Hours=Sun, Days=Moon, Signs=Year/Ritual), the Astronomy roll needed for each, and what happens when the calculation fails or botches.
quotes: Die Roll + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. 6 + Number of Diameters Desired
Die roll + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. 6 + Number of Hours Desired
The maximum duration is one year, regardless of all other factors.

entries.title: Favorable Hour for Spellcasting
entries.summary: The magus can identify one favorable hour per day for a casting bonus of +1 to +5, with a roll against three times the desired bonus and a penalty equal to the bonus if botched.
quotes: Only one hour in any day will favor the maga.
Stress Die + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. Three Times Desired Bonus

entries.title: Options: Calculating an Astrological Duration
entries.summary: Optional modifiers to the Astronomy Ease Factor: a Daily Horoscope, exact astrological time, precision end time, an armillary sphere, or non-stress calculation.
quotes: Calculate Daily Horoscope: Subtract 3 from Ease Factor
Precision Astrology (Specify Exact End Time): Add 3 to Ease Factor
Consult a Magical Armillary Sphere: Halve the Adjusted Ease Factor (after all Additions and Subtractions)

entries.title: The Time of Favorable Hour
entries.summary: A quick dice procedure for the storyguide to decide which hour of the day is favorable instead of using astrological tables.
quotes: then divide by 4 (round up)

entries.title: Astrologically Linked Enchantments
entries.summary: Enchantments can be linked to a single target by a Nativity Horoscope, giving a Lab Total bonus, or attuned to a cycle of signs, adding bonuses and opposing penalties to Penetration or frequency.
quotes: add the bonus for a Nativity Horoscope (+2)
The astrological cycle adjustment is the maga's Artes Liberales (Astronomy) score at the time she opens the device for enchantment

related.text: ArM5 p.84 Arcane Connection Bonus table

entries.title: New Enchanted Device: Magical Armillary Sphere
entries.summary: Introduces the magical armillary sphere, an enchanted device that reports astrological conditions and eases calculation of Astrological Durations.
quotes: greatly assists in calculating and working with Astrological Durations

entries.title: Making an Armillary Sphere
entries.summary: Rolls to design and craft a precision mundane armillary sphere, with higher Ease Factors when another person designs or crafts it and a season of work required.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. an Ease Factor of 12
Stress Die + Dexterity + Craft (Mechanisms or Clocks) vs. an Ease Factor of 12
The Ease Factors are reduced by 3 if copying an existing precision armillary sphere.

entries.title: Enchanting the Armillary Sphere
entries.summary: The vis needed to open the armillary sphere as an invested device and the two constant effects (Know the Heavens, Track the Heavens) that sense and keep it set to local astrological time.
quotes: The mechanism must be opened as an invested device, needing 15 pawns (base metal, x3 for skull sized), or 18 if constructed of silver, 30 for gold.

entries.title: Consulting the Armillary Sphere
entries.summary: Using the sphere halves the Ease Factor for Astrological Duration calculations; for a distant location the magus must know conditions there and adjust the sphere with a roll.
quotes: This halves the Ease Factor of Astrological Duration calculations.
To Adjust the Armillary Sphere: Stress Die + Intelligence + Astronomy vs. an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Structure of the Magoi of the Star
entries.requires: Mystery Cult: Magoi of the Star
entries.summary: The seven degrees of the Magoi of the Star and the Virtue Initiated at each (Planetary Magic, Potent Magic, Periapt, Celestial Magic, a Magical Focus or further Potent Magic, Divination and Augury: Astrology), with the Lore prerequisite for the first degree.
quotes: The cult is organized into seven separate degrees of Initiation.
To be Initiated requires a knowledge of Artes Liberales at 4 or greater

entries.title: Divination & Augury — Major Supernatural Virtue
entries.summary: Introduces Hermetic Divination as interpretive, not predictive, and subject to the Limit of Time.
quotes: The divination is inherently interpretive in nature and not predictive, and is subject to the Limit of Time

entries.title: Hermetic Divination
entries.summary: Hermetic Divination gives results equivalent to Intellego spells of any Form, and is more flexible than Formulaic Magic but weaker, covering all ten Forms with a single Ability.
quotes: Hermetic Divination provides results equivalent to casting Hermetic Intellego spells of any Form.

entries.title: Method and Additional Methods
entries.summary: Choosing a method of divination, how the first Initiation grants Divination at level 1, and how extra methods are added as Minor Virtues with prerequisites for Astrology, Numerology and Dream Interpretation.
quotes: the Initiation rites enable him to learn the Supernatural Ability Divination at level 1

entries.title: Divination: its limits
entries.summary: Divination only answers questions, is limited to Momentary effects, and cannot simulate Ritual Magic.
quotes: Hermetic Divination cannot simulate the effects of Ritual Magic.

entries.title: Divination: Ease Factor
entries.summary: Any non-Ritual Intellego question of Momentary Duration can be attempted; the Ease Factor is the equivalent spell level and the diviner rolls Characteristic + Divination + Aura + Bonuses against it.
quotes: Stress Die + Characteristic + Divination + Aura + Bonuses vs. Ease Factor
The Ease Factor for Hermetic Divination is the level of the equivalent Hermetic spell.
In Divination, an Arcane Connection held in the hand may be interpreted as if the diviner were Touching the target

entries.title: Example Divinations
entries.summary: Worked examples of working out the Ease Factor for common divination questions from equivalent Intellego guidelines.
quotes: The Ease Factor is 15 (Base 10, +1 Eye, or +1 touching an AC).

entries.title: Divination: Penetration
entries.summary: A divination's Penetration is the Divination Total plus Penetration Bonus less the Ease Factor.
quotes: Divination Total + Penetration Bonus – Ease Factor

entries.title: Ceremonial Augury Phenomena
entries.summary: Table of divination methods, what each observes, and the Ceremonial Bonus it gives for different types of question.

entries.title: Casual Divination
entries.summary: Divination taking one round by reading signs in the immediate environment, rolled with Perception against the equivalent spell level, with no open-ended roll.
quotes: Casual Divination takes one round
Stress Die + Perception + Divination + Aura + Bonus vs. Ease Factor (Equivalent Spell Level)

entries.title: Ceremonial Divination
entries.summary: A slower divination, taking time per magnitude of Ease Factor, that allows sympathetic magic and devices and uses Intelligence in the roll.
quotes: Ceremonial Divination takes 15 minutes per 5 Ease Factors (the same as 15 minutes per magnitude)
Stress Die + Intelligence + Divination + Aura + Bonuses vs. Ease Factor (Equivalent Spell Level)

entries.title: Divination Bonuses
entries.summary: The three bonuses added to a Ceremonial Divination roll: Ceremonial Bonus (+1 to +5 from the method), Sympathetic Magic Bonus from Arcane Connections and similar links, and Magical Bonus from an enchanted divinatory device.
quotes: This ranges from +1 to +5.
The magus adds Ceremonial Bonus, sympathetic bonus, and Magic Bonus to the roll against the Ease Factor for the divination.

entries.title: Hermetic Dream Interpreter — Major Supernatural Mystery Virtue
entries.summary: Dream interpretation as a specialised divination method, which can also be Initiated as an extra Minor Virtue by a diviner.
quotes: Hermetic Dream Interpretation permits Casual and Ceremonial Divination in a specialized manner through the interpretation of dreams.

entries.title: Hermetic Dream Interpretation
entries.summary: States that Hermetic Dream Interpretation uses the Divination and Augury rules plus the special uses described afterwards.
quotes: Hermetic Dream Interpretation uses the rules for Hermetic Divination and Augury in this chapter.

entries.title: Divinatory Interpretation
entries.summary: Using dream interpretation as Ceremonial Divination by ritual preparation before sleep, or by discussing another person's dream for at least an hour.
quotes: This takes approximately half an hour of preparation

entries.title: Enchantment of the Scrying Device
entries.summary: A general Effect enchanted into a divinatory device whose level sets the Magical Bonus to Ceremonial Divination.
quotes: Magical Bonus = Effect level / 10 (round up)

entries.title: Symbolic Interpretation
entries.summary: A non-divinatory dream reading made with an interpretation total compared to the Ease Factor table to judge how clearly the dream is understood.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + Divination (Dream Interpretation)

entries.title: Dream Calling
entries.summary: A supernatural action to ensure a touched person dreams about a chosen subject, rolled against Ease Factor 6.
quotes: Stress Die + Presence + Dream Interpretation + Aura vs. an Ease Factor of 6

entries.title: Hermetic Empowerment (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue, built on Spell Binding, that lets a magus enchant Ritual effects into a device and power them by draining a bound spirit instead of paying vis. The text lists which Ritual effects can and cannot be empowered this way.
quotes: Invoking a spirit-powered vis-using effect takes no more time or effort on the part of the person triggering the device than any other device invested effect.

entries.title: Hermetic Empowerment: Enchanting the Device
entries.summary: How to instill a Ritual effect into a device with Hermetic Empowerment: the process matches normal enchanting, the effect keeps Ritual minimum level, and it stays inert until a spirit powers it.
quotes: Just like a Ritual spell, the minimum level of a Ritual effect is 20

entries.title: Hermetic Empowerment: Powering Ritual Effects
entries.summary: A bound spirit powers an empowered Ritual effect by permanently losing Might Score, and it can only power effects up to a limit set by its Might. Also covers what happens when the device is broken and the spirit is released.
quotes: Might Score drained = (Ritual level/5) (round up)
Might Score x 2 must equal or exceed Ritual level

entries.title: Suitable Spirits for a Magus' Magic (sidebar)
entries.requires: Virtue: Hermetic Empowerment or Spirit Familiar
entries.summary: Sidebar saying the realm of a spirit must match the magus's own magic before he can take it as a familiar or drain its Might for Ritual power.
quotes: then the realm of the spirit must in some way match the magus's magic

entries.title: Empowering Prison of the Declining Spirit (sidebar)
entries.summary: The special Mystery general enchantment that traps a spirit in a device and lets its Might Score fuel Ritual effects; sets how its level relates to the spirit's Might, its Form requisites and per-day uses.
quotes: The base level of the enchantment must equal or exceed twice the Might of the spirit that will be bound to it.
the current Might Score of the bound spirit must equal or exceed half the level of the Ritual effect to be powered

entries.title: Spirit Familiar (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue letting a magus ally with a ghost or other incorporeal spirit as a familiar, using rules close to those for animal familiars. A magus may have only one familiar, animal or spirit; the Lab Total for binding uses a suitable Technique and Form.
quotes: A magus may only have one familiar, be it animal or spirit
The Lab Total for binding a spirit familiar is the same as an animal familiar: any appropriate Technique and any appropriate Form.

entries.title: Finding a Suitable Spirit
entries.summary: Guidance on locating and persuading a spirit to become a familiar: visit its haunts, bargain with free-willed spirits, and match its nature to the magus's best Technique and Form.

entries.title: Bonding the Ally as Spirit Familiar
entries.summary: The Lab Total, bonding level and vis cost for bonding a spirit as a familiar, with the aura modifier taken from the worse of magus or spirit.
quotes: Any Technique + Any Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura Modifier
Spirit's Might + 25
1 pawn of vis per 5 levels or fraction; which must match the Technique or Form

entries.title: Becoming Immortal with a Spirit Familiar (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar noting that a spirit familiar, already immortal, accompanies its magus through a transformation into an immortal being without needing extra vis.

entries.title: The Three Cords
entries.summary: Describes the three cords of a spirit familiar bond (Hermes, Isis and Hekate) and the extra benefits each gives, including spending the spirit's Might on Stamina rolls and transferring Might points.
quotes: Up to 5 Might points may be spent on one roll.
he can give his spirit familiar a number of Temporary Might points equal to his bond score by spending 1 level of Fatigue

entries.title: Spirit Familiar Sample Powers (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar of sample bond powers for a spirit familiar (communication, senses, location, speech, apparition, corporeality, incorporeality), with how each is built as a Hermetic effect.

entries.title: The Bonded Spirit Familiar
entries.summary: What bonding does to the spirit: mutual True Friend and Loyal traits, an Arcane Connection both ways, how Magic Resistance works, languages, and building its Characteristics from pyramid points.
quotes: You have (Might/5) pyramid points to start with, rather than the 7 points of a normal character.

entries.title: Empowering the Bond
entries.summary: States that the normal familiar rules for empowering the bond apply to a spirit familiar, including the limit on who the powers can target.

entries.title: Inscription on the Soul (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue letting a magus make his own spirit and body his talisman, opened with vis and attuned over a season. A magus may have only one talisman at a time.
quotes: The magus's spirit and body are opened initially with 15 pawns of vis

entries.title: Enchantment and Magical Attunements
entries.summary: Benefits of the soul talisman: the usual talisman Lab Total bonus, effect expiry treated as seventy years, and a limited range of Shape and Material Bonuses from the human body.
quotes: A magus gains the usual talisman bonus of +5 to Lab Total for enchantments to his talisman

related.text: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material Bonuses

entries.title: Hermetic Empowerment and Inscription on the Soul (sidebar)
entries.requires: Virtue: Inscription on the Soul and Hermetic Empowerment
entries.summary: Sidebar on combining the two Virtues: binding a spirit into the magus's own body or spirit, and triggering Ritual effects from it, each inflict a Warping Point.

entries.title: Spirit vs. Body Enchantments
entries.summary: Explains when it matters whether an enchantment is placed in the spirit or the body (default is spirit; body if Shape and Material Bonuses from the body or Blending With Substance are used).

entries.title: Blending with Substance
entries.summary: How a magus embeds a small item in his flesh to attune its Shape and Material bonuses: an effect level is calculated from the item's bonuses, a Rego Vim effect with requisites is enchanted, and Warping Points are inflicted.
quotes: Total the highest bonus, and half the sum of any other bonuses, and multiply by 5 to get an effect level.

entries.title: The Great or Consummate Talisman (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar comparing Blending with Substance to the Great Talisman Virtue and noting it does not allow attuning new bonuses without working on the talisman.

entries.title: Vulgar Alchemy and Blending With Substance (sidebar)
entries.requires: Virtue: Inscription on the Soul; Initiation: Hermetic Alchemy
entries.summary: Sidebar saying Shape and Material items found by Vulgar Alchemy must be fully integrated into Hermetic theory (a tractatus) before they can be used in Blending With Substance.

entries.title: Talisman Connection
entries.summary: Describes how the magus's body and spirit remain connected and mutually Arcane Connections if separated, and how enchantments in each can be removed.

entries.title: Living Ghost (Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: The Major Mystery in which a magus binds his spirit to an area before a ritual death and becomes a free-willed ghost who keeps his abilities. It is done through invented Mystery Ritual spells; Hermetic legal protection is lost at death.

entries.title: Preparing for the Transformation
entries.summary: The magus must invent personal versions of two Mystery Ritual spells, Bind the Living Ghost and Transformation of the Living Ghost, as the lab preparation for the Ordeal.

entries.title: Bind The Living Ghost (Mystery Ritual)
entries.summary: The Mystery Ritual that defines the magus's Haunt, the area his ghost is bound to. The design level depends on the area Target chosen, and the levels spent enlarging the area feed into the Transformation spell.
quotes: Cr(Pe/Re)Me(Co) (30 + area Size)
(Base 30, + magnitudes to increase area from Individual)

entries.title: Transformation of the Living Ghost (Mystery Ritual)
entries.summary: The unique general-level Mystery Ritual that sets a Living Ghost's Might Score, capped by a transformation limit from his best Technique and Form and reduced by the levels reserved for the size of the Haunt.
quotes: Transformation Limit = Best Technique and Form Combination
Size Levels = Levels Added to Increase Target of Bind the Living Ghost
Might Score = Ritual Spell Level – Size Levels

entries.title: A Living Ghost
entries.summary: How the Ordeal is performed (cast Transformation, then Bind), that it can be attempted only once, and what a Living Ghost is like afterwards: self-aware, able to learn with difficulty, tied to its Haunt, and still linked to its talisman.

entries.title: Ghosts in Ars Magica (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar defining how ghosts work in the game: appearance and invisibility, inability to learn or change, solidity to other ghosts, spellcasting as illusion unless they have powers, returning after being defeated, fetters, and the vis left behind.

entries.title: Hazards of Becoming a Living Ghost (sidebar)
entries.requires: Initiation: Living Ghost; Virtue: Inscription on the Soul
entries.summary: Sidebar on the danger of a body-linked talisman: destroying the body breaks its attunements and gives Warping Points as a single event, and entering Twilight mid-process means the Ritual fails.

entries.title: Learning and the Immortal Spirit
entries.summary: An immortal, unaging spirit resists study and learning; a Living Ghost can get round this by enchanting his talisman as described for immortal magi.

entries.title: Familiars and the Living Ghost
entries.summary: A spirit familiar stays with its magus automatically; another familiar can join him in living death if the magus spends extra raw vis based on the bond score.
quotes: provided the magus expends additional pawns of raw vis equal to the Familiar Bond Score/5 (round up)

related.text: Appendix A: Immortal Magi, Becoming Immortal with a Familiar

entries.title: The Haunt
entries.summary: Explains that a Living Ghost depends on its Haunt continuing to exist, and compares the stability of Circle, Room, Structure and Boundary Targets.

entries.title: Magic and the Living Ghost
entries.summary: The Might powers a Living Ghost uses (Ghostly Body, Ghostly Magic, Ghostly Vis), how Fatigue and unconsciousness still affect it, and what happens when its Might runs out.
quotes: by spending 1 point of Temporary Might per magnitude of the effect
the Living Ghost can permanently expend points of Might Score, with each point equivalent to one pawn of raw vis

entries.title: Manipulating the World as a Ghost
entries.summary: How an insubstantial Living Ghost acts on the world: using Rego spells and enchanted devices, possessing bodies, working in a lab, and the penalty of being forced out of a body away from the Haunt.

entries.title: Re-Enchanting the Spirit
entries.requires: Initiation: Living Ghost; Virtue: Inscription on the Soul
entries.summary: A Living Ghost who spent Might Score as vis can restore or increase it by opening unused talisman spaces and recasting Transformation of the Living Ghost; the Might Score stays capped by the Technique and Form limit.

gated.title: Hermetic Theurgy
gated.intro: Theurgy, Synthemata and the Names of Power.

entries.title: Daimons (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar defining Daimons as ancient named spirits that appear through an Aspect; magi summon only an Aspect and cannot truly threaten the Daimon. A magus must know something of a Daimon, or hold a Lab Text, to create a summoning spell.

entries.title: Name of Power Spell (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar describing the Name of Power (X) general-level Muto Vim spell, which gives a bonus with a scope agreed with the troupe, built on the Shape and Material Bonus idea.
quotes: The level of spell is five times the desired bonus. Range, Duration, and Target are fixed.

entries.title: Names of Power (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue where a Name of Power is learned as a Muto Vim spell giving a bonus equal to its spell magnitude, usable only with other Mystery Virtues. Names must be spoken aloud, so quiet or silent casting cannot be combined.
quotes: All uses of Names of Power require that the maga speak the names out loud in a firm (or loud) voice

entries.title: Synthemata (sidebar)
entries.requires: Virtue: Hermetic Synthemata or Synthemata Magia
entries.summary: Sidebar explaining that synthemata are signs, symbols or passwords linking a magician to a spirit; most theurgic spells merely include them, but special Virtues let a magus use them as a channel to command spirits.

entries.title: Hermetic Theurgy and Names of Power
entries.requires: Virtue: Names of Power and Hermetic Theurgy
entries.summary: How to work a Name of Power into an Invoke spell: its bonus is added to the Lab Total for inventing the spell and to the Casting Score, capped by Magic Theory, and the names must be spoken aloud.
quotes: The total value of all Names of Power combined in a spell cannot exceed her Magic Theory when she invents the spell.
Theurgic Name Bonus = Total Name of Power Bonuses, Limited by Magic Theory

entries.title: Spirits and Realms (sidebar)
entries.requires: Virtue: Hermetic Theurgy or Spirit Familiar
entries.summary: Sidebar on which spirits a magus can work with: Magic Might spirits for all magi, Faerie spirits with Faerie Magic, Infernal spirits through diabolic practices, and Divine spirits with Divine magic.

entries.title: Invocation Magic and Names of Power
entries.requires: Virtue: Invocation Magic and Names of Power
entries.summary: How a magus with Invocation Magic casts Names of Power as meta-magic spells in sequence to raise the Casting Score of a following spell; the bonus is limited by Magic Theory and can combine with theurgic and talisman bonuses.
quotes: Invocation Magic Bonus = Total of Name of Power Spell Bonuses, Limited by Magic Theory

entries.title: Consummate Talisman and Names of Power
entries.requires: Virtue: Consummate Talisman and Names of Power
entries.summary: A talisman with the Consummate Talisman Virtue can hold Name of Power effects that add to the magus's Casting Score when he speaks the triggering names aloud, limited by Magic Theory.
quotes: Talisman Name of Power Bonus = Total of Name of Power Effect Bonuses, Limited by Magic Theory

related.text: Chapter 10: The Great Talisman, Consummate Talisman

entries.title: Spell Spirits (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar on the spirits summoned by Invoke spells: limited intelligence, how others can resist or command them (must exceed the level of the Invoke spell), and that a magus designs the spell first and the spirit follows.

entries.title: Invocation Magic (Major Mystery Virtue)
entries.requires: Virtue: Invocation Magic (prerequisite: Names of Power)
entries.summary: A Major Mystery Virtue that lets a magus cast Names of Power as Muto Vim spells on himself to add to his Casting Score for the next spell. Covers casting time for each name, the voice requirement, and the special botch consequences.
quotes: Invocation Magic Bonus = Total of Name of Power Spell Bonuses, Limited by Magic Theory
It takes the normal spellcasting time to invoke each Name of Power preceding the main spell

entries.title: Hermetic Theurgy (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue for inventing Invoke spells, each of which forms a pact with one specific named spirit; the base level is the spirit's Might and Range, Duration and Target govern only the invocation. Invoke spells cannot be put into devices.
quotes: the base level is usually all that is needed to summon the spirit

entries.title: Inventing Theurgic Spells in the Laboratory
entries.summary: Gives the modified Lab Total used to research theurgic spells, and how Names of Power can be added to it and to the Casting Score.
quotes: Technique + Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura + (Realm) Lore + Bonuses

entries.title: Invoke the Spirit of (spell)
entries.summary: Mystery spell pact with a named spirit that casts one Formulaic-style spell as a power, with no die roll and no botch. Covers base level from the spirit's Might, Penetration like a device, the first-summons Magic Resistance check, and the spirit's Casting Score and success threshold.
quotes: Spirit Might must equal or exceed level of spell-like power
Penetration Bonus = 2 x added levels of
Spirit's Casting Score = Spirit's Might + Aura Modifier
Spellcasting Succeeds if Casting Total is at least (adjusted spell level –10)

entries.title: Invoke the Spirit of (Form)
entries.summary: Mystery spell pact with a named spirit that produces Spontaneous-style effects of one Technique and Form combination as a power; the spirit's Casting Total is half its Casting Score, with no die roll.
quotes: Casting Total = Casting Score/2 (round up) (no die roll)
Penetration Total = Spirit's Casting Total – Spell Level

entries.title: Invoke the Pact of (Daimon)
entries.requires: Virtue: Hermetic Theurgy (limited use without it)
entries.summary: Mystery Ritual that repeatedly calls a named Daimon until it sends an Aspect to answer. Each casting that beats its Magic Resistance accumulates Summoning Points, and it can be cast in limited form without Hermetic Theurgy.
quotes: Daimon Summoning Points = Spell Level – Daimon's Might
Summoning Success: Accumulated Summoning Points = Daimon's Might

entries.title: The Daimonic Aspect (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar explaining Aspects: each is an independent fraction of a Daimon with its own Might pool and no fatigue, which cannot be summoned where another Aspect of the same Daimon is or was within a day, and cannot be permanently changed.

entries.title: Theurgic Spirit Familiar (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: Name-magic version of the Spirit Familiar Virtue that also lets a powerful maga ally with a Daimon, binding only one Aspect of it while the bond is with the whole Daimon.

entries.title: Finding and Binding a Daimon
entries.summary: How a magus researches, summons and wins over a Daimon as a familiar, including a rule of thumb for when it will refuse and the vis sacrifice to the Daimon.
quotes: if the (Technique + Form) proposed for the bond is less than 2 x Might, it is likely to reject the magus as not worthy
equal to its Might/5 (round up)

entries.title: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes (Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes (prerequisite: Hermetic Theurgy)
entries.summary: A Major Mystery path to apotheosis, requiring Hermetic Theurgy, in which a hierarch devises two non-Hermetic Mystery Rituals that a group of celebrants must cast for him. No Warping is inflicted for the high level since the spells are for one magus.

entries.title: Ascendant Form of the Intendant Hierarch
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: The hierarch's own Mystery Ritual that manifests his abilities at their strongest. The level is at least the total of his best Technique and Form, and the resulting Might is half the Ritual level; celebrants must overcome his full Magic Resistance.
quotes: the ascended hierarch will have a Might of (this Ritual's level/2)
a minimum level of 40

entries.title: Familiars and the Ascendant Magus (sidebar)
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: Sidebar: a spirit familiar automatically ascends with its magus, while another familiar can join him if extra vis based on the bond score is spent in the Ritual.
quotes: provided additional pawns of raw vis equal to the Familiar Bond Score/5 (round up) are expended in the Ritual

related.text: Appendix A: Immortal Magi, Becoming Immortal with a Familiar

entries.title: Transformation of the Ascendant Hierarch
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: The celebrants' Ordeal Ritual cast on the hierarch; it must beat his Magic Resistance and exceed the Ascendant Form level, and the hierarch rolls Stamina against an Ease Factor to avoid passing out.
quotes: The hierarch makes a Stamina roll against an Ease Factor of 9, or passes out

entries.title: The Cumulative Transformation Process
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: How transformation points accumulate over repeated rituals and the total needed, which adds the Ascendant Form level and extra points for negative Characteristics, Decrepitude and excess Flaws.
quotes: Count Major Flaws and Virtues as 3 points each, Minor as 1 point each.
Flaws are Excessive if Flaws Exceed Virtues.
Level + 3 x cost of Negative Characteristics + 5 x Decrepitude + 5 x Flaw Points if Excessive

entries.title: Ascension to the Hall of Heroes
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: What happens at ascension: the magus becomes an immortal spirit that can be summoned, his talisman becomes part of his being, and his body is left as an Arcane Connection.

entries.title: Invoke the Pact of (Daimon): Daimonic Magus Summoned (sidebar)
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: Sidebar: a player-character Daimonic magus can be summoned by an Invoke Pact spell devised for him, earning pact benefits in exchange for a service; the Daimon gains a benefit tied to the spell level.
quotes: The spirit gains the benefit when the Invocation points total equals his Might, and he is called to appear.

entries.title: The Daimonic Magus
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: Describes the ascended Daimonic magus: Aspects in several places, immunity to aging and Warping, no laboratory use, and no Fatigue levels (Might is spent instead of Fatigue).
quotes: the Daimon expends 5 Might for each Fatigue level normally expended

entries.title: Learning and Improving as a Daimonic Spirit
entries.requires: Initiation: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
entries.summary: Daimon Points earned from pact summonings let a Daimonic magus fix study and spell experience, raise Might and Characteristics, and trade for lessons with other spirits.
quotes: Daimon Points = (spell level) / 5
5 Daimon Points can be used to increase Might Score by 1 point.

entries.title: Hermetic Synthemata (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue where a magus learns a being's synthemata, unique to it, as a key to boost Penetration past its Magic Resistance; useful for summoning Daimons but it makes the being ill-disposed.
quotes: Any being with a Might score has synthemata.

entries.title: Synthemata of (X)
entries.summary: Mystery spell unique to one named being whose level must equal or exceed that being's Might; it adds its level to the Penetration Total of the next spell cast.
quotes: the caster adds the synthemata level to the Penetration Total of any spell cast (or begun) immediately after the synthemata spell

entries.title: The Lasting Synthemata of (X)
entries.summary: Diameter-duration version of the synthemata spell that gives a Penetration bonus of its level reduced by a fixed amount for multiple castings, and makes the being aware of the threat.
quotes: the (spell level – 5) must equal or exceed its Might

entries.title: Researching Synthemata (Hermetic)
entries.summary: Lab rules for inventing a synthemata spell: the base level must reach the target's Might, (Realm) Lore replaces Magic Theory, sympathetic connections add bonuses, and name hiding reduces seasonal progress.
quotes: Lab Total = Muto + Vim + Intelligence + (Realm) Lore + Aura + Bonuses
Spell Points Accumulated = (Lab Total – Spell Level – Name Hiding)
Typical Name Hiding = (Might / 2)

entries.title: Revealing Synthemata
entries.summary: A commanded powerful spirit may reveal the synthemata of spirits it controls, which lets the magus skip name hiding when researching them; includes a guideline for how many a spirit knows.
quotes: assume a powerful spirit may know synthemata of other spirits whose Might Scores add up to no more than its own Might, and no individual higher than its own Might/2

entries.title: Synthemata Magia (Major Supernatural Mystery Ability)
entries.summary: A non-Hermetic Major Supernatural Ability, predecessor of Hermetic synthemata research, that uses (Realm) Lore and lets a magus intuit a being's synthemata quickly at the cost of a weaker effect.

entries.title: Intuit Synthemata
entries.summary: Roll of Perception plus (Realm) Lore against the being's Might and name hiding, adjusted by auras, to intuit a being's synthemata in its presence; success gives a personal Muto Vim guideline to boost Casting Score against it, and botches alert the spirit.
quotes: Stress Die + Perception + (Realm) Lore + Magus's Aura Modifier vs. Might + Spirit's Aura Modifier + Name Hiding
Add spell level to the caster's Casting Score for spells cast while this spell lasts.

entries.title: The Hedge Lord's Synthemata of (X)
entries.summary: Spell template for the Synthemata Magia version of a synthemata spell, adding a reduced level to Casting Score against one named being for a short Diameter.
quotes: The spell adds its (level – 5) to the caster's Casting Score against the named being for two minutes.

entries.title: Researching Synthemata (Synthemata Magia)
entries.summary: A season of fasting and invocation lets a Synthemata Magia user learn the synthemata of a being previously met in person, by an Ability roll against its Might plus name hiding; failure does not bar further tries.
quotes: Stress Die + Perception + (Realm) Lore + Aura Modifier + Bonuses vs. Might + Name Hiding

entries.title: Standard Talisman (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar recalling how an ordinary talisman is made: components cannot be added to an existing device, so compound items are built with as many components as Magic Theory allows, and vis handling is limited each season.
quotes: she should create and open a compound item with as many components as her Magic Theory score permits

entries.title: Great Talisman (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue that lets a magus open a talisman attunement merely by using it in regular magical life, and add new components when reopening it, still one attunement per season.
quotes: He can still only open one attunement per season, even if he reopens or invests an effect in his talisman.

entries.title: Consummate Talisman (Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.requires: Initiation: Consummate Talisman (prerequisite: Great Talisman or Inscription on the Soul)
entries.summary: A Major Mystery Virtue letting a talisman hold Personal-range Muto Vim effects that affect the magus's own spellcasting, including Name of Power effects, at the cost of a Flaw that counts as an Ordeal.
quotes: The magus may enchant Muto Vim effects, with Personal Range, into his talisman, and may use them on himself when he casts Formulaic spells.

entries.title: Inscription on the Soul and Talisman Virtues (sidebar)
entries.requires: Virtue: Inscription on the Soul; Great Talisman or Consummate Talisman
entries.summary: Sidebar on combining Inscription on the Soul with the talisman Virtues: body or spirit attunements can be opened with Great Talisman, and Inscription on the Soul can replace Great Talisman as the prerequisite for Consummate Talisman.

entries.title: New Spell Guidelines: Intellego (Form) counting (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar giving new Intellego (Form) guidelines for counting individuals in a Target, with or without sorting them into categories.

entries.title: New Spell Guidelines: Rego Terram (Hermetic Geometry) (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar with new Rego Terram guidelines for reshaping earth into perfect or imperfect geometric shapes.

entries.title: Hermetic Numerology (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue based on Artes Liberales (arithmetic) letting a magus devise small Rote formulae and enchant a Numerologist's Book for a bonus to Numerology, Geometry and Architecture; it is also a prerequisite for Divination (Numerology).

entries.title: The Numerologist's Book
entries.summary: How a Numerologist enchants a text as a lesser or greater book that gives a book bonus (capped by Artes Liberales arithmetic) to Divination, lab work and Rote casting, and how it is consulted.
quotes: Lesser Numerologist's Book Opened with 8 Pawns of vis
Lesser Book Bonus is +4
Greater Numerologist's Book Opened with 16 Pawns of vis
Greater Book Bonus is +8

entries.title: Magical Books (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar on how much vis a medieval book costs to open for enchantment (parchment, covers or both) and the new Book Shape Bonus granted.
quotes: +2 Intellego, +3 Divination, +4 Numerology

entries.title: Rotes
entries.summary: Rotes are small memorized spell-like formulae invoked with no die roll, as if with Quiet and Still Casting. Gives the Rote Lab Total, maximum level, Casting Score and Total, Penetration, and the cheaper invention cost.
quotes: Rote Lab Total = Technique + Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Arithmetic + Book Bonus + Aura Modifier
Maximum Rote Level = (Rote Lab Total) / 5
Rote Casting Score = Stamina + Technique + Form + Arithmetic + Book Bonus + Aura Modifier
Rote Casting Total = Casting Score / 2, rounded up.

entries.title: Creating the Numerologist's Book (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar on attuning a text as a Numerologist's Book while opening it: it adds only a short distraction, only its creator gets the bonus, and the lesser and greater versions cost different vis and Magic Theory.
quotes: The lesser Numerologist's Book is created by opening the parchment pages

entries.title: Hermetic Geometry (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue built on Euclid's postulates and Artes Liberales (geometry) that provides sympathetic magic through shapes, adding perfect-shape drawing, casting bonuses for figures, and new Line Range and Arcane Circle and Ring Targets.

entries.title: Drawing a Perfect Shape (sidebar)
entries.summary: Rules for scribing a perfect circle or other shape, needed for Arcane Circle and Arcane Ring: a Scribe roll with a hard Ease Factor freehand or an easier one with posts and string, plus the pace and Concentration limits while tracing.
quotes: Die Roll + Dexterity + Profession: Scribe vs. an Ease Factor of 15 if drawn freehand
Die Roll + Dexterity + Profession: Scribe vs. an Ease Factor of 6 if drawn with the aid of posts and string.

entries.title: Bonus for Circles, Rings, and Lines
entries.summary: A Casting Score bonus when a spell involves tracing a circle or line, including standard Circle and Ring spells.
quotes: the magus gains a bonus of +3 to his Casting Score

entries.title: Ceremonial Figures
entries.summary: Ceremonial Casting, even for Formulaic spells, with geometric and numerological figures gives a further Casting Score bonus that stacks with the circle bonus; describes which rooms and structures count as regular and the components needed for higher-magnitude spells.
quotes: may use Ceremonial Casting (even for Formulaic spells) and include complex Geometric and Numerological correspondences to gain a bonus of +3 to the Casting Score

entries.title: New Range: Line
entries.summary: New Range: Line, equivalent to Sight but needing only that the target be sensed. The magus must calculate the distant point with a Geometry roll against an Ease Factor from the Distance Level, taking rounds to scribe it; failure shifts the target.
quotes: Ease Factor = Distance Level (minimum 9)
Die Roll + Intelligence + Artes Liberales (Arithmetic) vs. Ease Factor
Time Taken = (Ease Factor / 3) Rounds (round up)

entries.title: Distance Level table (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar table converting a distance in paces into a Distance Level, used as the Ease Factor for Line Range calculations.
quotes: Treat the length of the line in paces as if points to purchase a score in an Ability.

entries.title: New Target: Arcane Circle and New Duration: Arcane Ring
entries.summary: New Target Arcane Circle and new Duration Arcane Ring let a magus cast a circle spell on a remote circle by tracing a perfect circle she can reach; the spell breaks if either circle is broken, and the centre is located like a Line Range.
quotes: The line traced must be a perfect circle (as opposed to the standard Circle Target).

entries.title: Extended Material and Size Table (sidebar)
entries.summary: Table extending the Material and Size multipliers to huge rooms, structures and boundaries, giving the enchantment points needed for wood, soft stone and hard stone.
quotes: small room (3 paces by 3 paces) = Ind x 10

related.text: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size table

entries.title: Hermetic Architecture (Minor Mystery Virtue)
