entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue for enchanting very large things, such as rooms, buildings, groves and stone circles, by enchanting a set of smaller devices placed in a pattern. The amount of enchantment is the Material times the Size multiplier.
quotes: Multiply Material cost times the Size multiplier of the structure to be enchanted

entries.title: Compound Component Devices
entries.summary: The magus finds a matching component device, makes as many identical copies as the structure's Size multiplier, and places them in a calculated pattern, which needs a Geometry roll; failure takes time to recompute and a botch brings disaster.
quotes: Intelligence + Artes Liberales (Geometry) vs. an Ease Factor of 6 + Size Multiplier

entries.title: Seasonal Vis Limits and Very Large Structures (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar on getting around the seasonal vis limit for huge structures by having others open the component devices, using Verditius, Celestial Magic or Philosophic Alchemy to reduce the vis needed.
quotes: Since a magus is limited to twice Magic Theory pawns of vis in a single season in the laboratory

entries.title: Investing the Effects
entries.summary: How lab enchanting works for the component devices of a structure: Material and Shape Bonuses from both components and the intended structure, a choice of structure or device targets, and permission to invest Boundary-target effects.

entries.title: Completing and Binding the Enchantment
entries.summary: After the devices are placed, the magus casts a Mystery rite, formulated as a spell for calculation and vis cost, to link the finished components.

entries.title: Bind the Mystical Structure (Mystery Ritual)
entries.summary: The Mystery Ritual that links the placed component devices into one enchanted structure. Its base level exceeds the highest component effect level by a fixed amount and it needs Arcane Range, with extra levels for larger sizes.
quotes: The base level of the ritual must equal or exceed 5 + level of the highest component device effect levels.
(Create a conduit for spells up to (level + 5 magnitudes), +4 Arcane, +2 Group)

entries.title: Breaking the Device
entries.summary: Component devices may be removed from their niches without destroying the binding, but the effect stops while any is missing; a Muto requisite on the binding fuses devices and holders so they cannot be separated without breakage.

entries.title: Investigating the Structure
entries.summary: Rules for investigating the component devices in a normal lab, where the investigative Lab Total is halved, and the opacity of Architecture and Geometry enchantments to those without the Mystery.
quotes: the magus's investigative Lab Total is halved

entries.title: Boosting Magical Auras
entries.summary: Introduces the ability of Hermetic Architecture to manipulate magical auras and regiones, which is normally beyond Hermetic magic and available only to those initiated in the Virtue.

entries.title: Increase of the Room's Modest Aura (sample enchantment)
entries.summary: Sample Architecture enchantment raising the magical aura of a room by one level up to a cap; shows the procedure for enchanting a room, with the magus's own lab enchanted in place and other rooms needing the full structural method.
quotes: Increases the Magical aura in a room by +1, to a maximum aura level of 5.
(Base 55, +1 Touch, +2 Room, +14 levels always on)

entries.title: New Aura Magic Guidelines (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar of new Creo, Muto and Rego Vim guidelines for raising auras, changing the size of auras and regiones, closing regiones and linking regio levels; usable only in structural enchantments of Hermetic Architecture.
quotes: Increase the level of a Magical aura by +1 to a maximum of 9 — greatest increase possible
Double or halve the linear size of a Magical aura.

entries.title: Bountiful Boundary's Splendid Aura (sample enchantment)
entries.summary: Sample Architecture enchantment raising the aura of a standard Boundary by one level up to a cap, with its component, Geometry roll and binding level worked out.
quotes: Increases the Magical aura in a standard Boundary by +1, to a maximum aura level of 6.

entries.title: Enchantment of the Magnified Regio (sample enchantment)
entries.summary: Sample Architecture enchantment that doubles the size of a magical regio, up to a limit, using a ring of pillars set at the old and new perimeters.
quotes: Increases the size of a Magical regio, doubling its size to a maximum of 200 paces across.

entries.title: Closed Privacy of the Enchanted Regio (sample enchantment)
entries.summary: Sample Architecture enchantment that shrinks the interface between regio levels until it pinches off, so the inner level can no longer be walked into or seen from the adjacent one.
quotes: (Base 35, +1 Touch, +4 Boundary, +1 to affect the interface only, +14 levels always on)

entries.title: Conjunction of the Mystic Veils (sample enchantment)
entries.summary: Sample Architecture enchantment creating a password-opened gateway between two levels of a regio from four devices; each gate is one-way, and bidirectional travel needs two gates.
quotes: A single gateway allows travel in one direction only; to make a gate bidirectional, the caster needs two gates (eight component devices).

entries.title: Dream Magic (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue, from a Baltic folk tradition systematized by Raisa of Novgorod, whose Mystery spells let a magus's spirit enter and act within dreams.

entries.title: Spiritual Dream Travel
entries.summary: How a spirit traveler enters a dream while the body lies in a trance: dream logic and time apply, disturbances to the body require Concentration rolls to stay, and an Arcane Connection to the body allows waking and use of real-world vis.
quotes: Physical disturbances to a traveler's body, such as being shaken or yelled at, require Concentration rolls

entries.title: The Stuff of Dreams (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar explaining that dreams are Mentem to create, enter or change from outside, but Imaginem for changes made within the dream.

entries.title: The Spiritual Traveler
entries.summary: What a spirit traveler keeps in a dream: Techniques, Imaginem as the only Form, Parma Magica, Virtues and Flaws, and a dream copy of the talisman, while the body is protected only by Form scores unless Parma is split between body and spirit.
quotes: reducing his effective Parma score by 3

entries.title: Dream Magic Spells: Duration and Target Dream
entries.summary: Introduces the new Duration: Dream and Target: Dream, which exist only for the length of one sleeper's dream, along with rules for magic and vis within dreams.
quotes: Dream Duration is equivalent to Concentration.
Dream Target is equivalent to Individual.

entries.title: Magic in Dream (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar on casting in dreams: every spell is cast as Imaginem using the magus's Imaginem score, durations run on dream time, rituals can be spontaneous with dream vis, and real-world vis is needed to affect anything beyond the dream.
quotes: A spirit traveler in a dream casts a spell of any Form as an Imaginem spell.
Real-world vis can only be used for known (non-Spontaneous) Rituals

entries.title: Dream Vis (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar saying dream vis is easily found, is nearly always Imaginem, and has no effect outside dreams; real-world vis must be carried on the body or brought by a physical traveler.

entries.title: New Spell Guidelines: Muto Mentem (Dream) (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar of Muto Mentem (Dream, Mystery) guidelines for changing a dream to include the caster's spirit, another's spirit, or a group; Range is the greater of the range to the dreamer or to the bodies involved.

entries.title: Time and Travel
entries.summary: Dream navigation is associative rather than geographical and dream time is flexible, a traveler does not sleep in a dream, and permanent changes are lost on leaving. Advice to the storyguide on running dream-logic travel.
quotes: They cannot have a dream within a dream.

entries.title: Encounters in Dream
entries.summary: What can be met in a dream: dream-people know only what the dreamer or caster intends, and a traveler may check pockets to find modest common objects, including a little dream vis, at the storyguide's discretion.
quotes: Dream-people are people as perceived by the dreamer (not the traveler).

entries.title: The Dreamer in Control (Lucid Dreaming)
entries.summary: Rolls for a dreamer to notice travelers and to reshape her own dream, with bonuses for magical power; the rolled total acts as the magnitude of a dream spell. The storyguide may also let a dreamer change the dream unconsciously.
quotes: To Become Aware of Travelers: Stress Die + Perception + Awareness vs. an Ease Factor of 9
To Reshape a Dream: Stress Die + Intelligence + Bonuses vs. an Ease Factor of 9
Dream Shaping Magnitude = Rolled Total
+3 if the dreamer has Dream Magic

entries.title: Time and Experience in Dream
entries.summary: Travelers can learn information in a dream but gain no game experience, and lab work such as inventing spells or enchanting is impossible.
quotes: they do not gain game points for Arts and Abilities

entries.title: Spell Botches in Dream
entries.summary: A botch in a dream produces nightmare effects, and gives the magus real Warping Points and Twilight checks; Twilight is measured in real-world time and removes him from the dream meanwhile.
quotes: A magus botching a spell accumulates real Warping points and must check for Twilight as normal.

entries.title: Fatigue and Wounds
entries.summary: Spirits in dreams ignore Fatigue, and wounds are not real but their shock is: the traveler rolls Stamina against the total Wound Penalty or is thrown out of the dream. Also covers attacks that reduce a traveler's Imaginem 'Might'.
quotes: Stress Die + Stamina + Modifiers vs. an Ease Factor of Total Wound Penalty
An Incapacitating wound has an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Aging in Dream
entries.summary: A spiritual traveler ages only as she chooses in a dream, while her body is subject to normal effects including aging and death; a traveler who never returns may gain a form of immortality.
quotes: While the spirit is in a dream, the body is subject to all normal effects, including aging.

entries.title: The Greater Dream Grimoire (Minor Mystery Virtue)
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue, requiring Dream Magic, for entering a dream physically through a portal and for giving dream objects real substance. Physical travelers suffer real and permanent effects and perceive spiritual travelers as illusion, while they are perceived as real.
quotes: Traveling physically into dreams is like crossing into a Regio, unlike spiritual travel.

entries.title: Time, Travel, and Objects
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: Physical travelers experience normal time and movement, cannot find objects on their person, resist dream logic applied to themselves, and are expelled if the dreamer wakes; real objects hidden in a dream are easy for them to retrieve.

entries.title: Life and Limb
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: Physical travelers suffer Fatigue and Wounds, need food and sleep, and heal and age at normal rates; dream food lacks real nourishment.
quotes: Consuming dream-food is like consuming food created by magic but without vis

entries.title: Spellcasting (Greater Dream Grimoire)
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: Physical travelers cast with their normal Hermetic Forms and can cast real-world spells that affect dreams, making them much more powerful than spiritual travelers; dream aura follows the setting.
quotes: Physical travelers cast spells as normal, responding to the Forms of dream as if they had normal Hermetic Forms.

entries.title: Vis and Physical Travelers
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: Any vis can be used in a dream, but only real-world vis brought by a physical traveler has real effects and is permanently spent. Effects sustained by dream vis vanish on return, though Momentary Creo rituals create real effects.
quotes: If real-world vis is used, it is gone forever, just as if used in the real world.

entries.title: Spells of the Greater Dream Grimoire
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: States that the Range of these spells is the greater of the range to the dream target or to the people or objects affected.

entries.title: New Guidelines
entries.requires: Virtue: The Greater Dream Grimoire (prerequisite: Dream Magic)
entries.summary: New Mystery guidelines for the Greater Dream Grimoire: giving dream objects real substance (as a Momentary Ritual using real-world vis, with extra levels for enchantments), moving bodies and objects through a portal into dreams, plus the sample spells that use them.
quotes: Creo Imaginem spells to give substance to an object must be cast in a dream by a spiritual traveler as a Momentary Ritual, using real-world vis
Give an object encountered in dream substance so that it can exist in the real world.

entries.title: The Dream Landscape
entries.summary: Dreams have rare natural portals to the dreamer's imagination and memory, and travelers leave portals back to where they entered; any traveler, whether spiritual, physical, demon or faerie, can use dream portals.

entries.title: The Mind's Imagination
entries.summary: The imagination behaves like dream but persists into waking time, so a traveler can stay inside a waking person's mind and may confront possessing spirits that have taken residence there.
quotes: the imagination persists beyond sleep, into waking time

entries.title: The Mind's Memory
entries.summary: Rules for exploring a dreamer's memory: ordinary memories are unstructured, an Art of Memory palace can be entered like a burglar, memories can be moved or strengthened, and a solid memory can be stolen, which removes it from the dreamer.
quotes: A solid memory can be removed (stolen) into the real world.

entries.title: The Dreamscape
entries.summary: The rumored shared dreamscape between dreams: only spiritual travelers can enter, there is no direct path back to the waking world so wounds do not expel them, the body cannot be woken, and the spirit can be killed by dream Mentem and Might attacks.
quotes: This is one of the few ways to kill a magus in dreams.

entries.title: Structure of the Volshebnii Mechtateli
entries.summary: How the dream-magic cult is organised: only two degrees, initiation offered in dream to those with strong Imaginem and Mentem aptitude, and the Virtues a mentor may teach beyond Dream Magic.
quotes: It acknowledges only two degrees

entries.title: The Death of A Thousand Nightmares (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar on the cult's penalty for intruders at the Vermilion Temple: an embodied personal nightmare that non-Initiates cannot escape, though Initiates can intervene with Imaginem magic.

entries.title: The Neo-Mercurians
entries.summary: The Neo-Mercurian Mystery Cult: its simple three-fold local ranks (Messengers, Congregation, Priests) and the list of Virtues it teaches by Initiation, which a storyguide may pick from.
quotes: The Neo-Mercurians have no system of degrees or ranks at local level, beyond a very simple three-fold division:

entries.title: Neo-Mercurian Road Magic: New Ranges and Targets
entries.requires: Virtue: Mercurian Magic; Road Magic taught or Initiated
entries.summary: New Ranges Road and Road Network and Targets Road and Road Network for Formulaic and Ritual spells (not Spontaneous), taught in one season to a maga with Mercurian Magic; each is equated to an existing level for spell design.
quotes: (For purposes of spell level calculation, Road is the same level as Voice.)
a standard Road size is 100 paces long
A standard Road Network is 10,000 paces long

entries.title: Cult of Mercury and Neo-Mercurian Spell Mastery Special Abilities (sidebar)
entries.requires: Mastery ability learned from a Cult of Mercury or True Lineages magus
entries.summary: Sidebar introducing the Mercurian Mastery special abilities: how they are learned from a teacher who knows them, chosen instead of the ArM5 abilities when gaining a Mastery level, and available to characters with Mastered Spells at creation.

entries.title: Ceremonial Casting
entries.requires: Mastery ability learned from a Cult of Mercury or True Lineages magus
entries.summary: Mastery ability allowing ceremonial methods for a non-Ritual spell, increasing casting time and adding Artes Liberales and Philosophiae to the total.
quotes: increasing the casting time and adding her Artes Liberales and Philosophiae to her total

entries.title: Disguised Casting
entries.requires: Mastery ability learned from a Cult of Mercury or True Lineages magus
entries.summary: Mastery ability allowing a magus to suppress or alter his sigil to hide his identity or mimic another magus's, adding Spell Mastery to the roll that determines how hard it is to recognize.
quotes: he may add his Spell Mastery score to the roll that determines how difficult it is to recognize

entries.title: Lab Mastery
entries.requires: Mastery ability learned from a Cult of Mercury or True Lineages magus
entries.summary: Mastery ability adding the spell mastery score to the Lab Total when designing effects similar to the mastered spell, on top of the standard similar spell bonus.
quotes: she may add her spell mastery score to her Lab Total when designing effects that are similar to it

entries.title: Learn From Mistakes
entries.requires: Mastery ability learned from a Cult of Mercury or True Lineages magus
entries.summary: Mastery ability giving experience toward mastery the first time in a session that the magus botches or narrowly fails a roll for the spell.
quotes: he gains 5 experience points toward mastery of this spell

entries.title: Stalwart Casting
entries.requires: Mastery ability learned from a Cult of Mercury or True Lineages magus
entries.summary: Mastery ability making a spell less tiring: a Ritual costs normal rather than long-term Fatigue and fewer levels, and a Formulaic spell never costs Fatigue for a low casting total.
quotes: she loses normal Fatigue instead of long-term Fatigue when casting it, and half as many Fatigue levels, rounded up (but always at least 1)

entries.title: Hermetic Sacrifice (Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue)
entries.summary: A Mystery Virtue where an unblemished sacrificial animal on a pagan altar substitutes for some of the vis for a Ritual that summons a deity; magic that forces the spirit spoils the altar.
quotes: A pure and satisfactory sacrifice substitutes for between one and six pawns of vis, depending on the nature of the animal.

gated.title: Mystery Cults of the Order
gated.intro: The Legion of Mithras, the Fraternity of Samos and other cults.

entries.title: Mystery Cults: Rumors and Using the Examples
entries.summary: Explains how the example cults are to be used and how a character hears rumor of a cult, and that initiation schedules are examples only: the Mystagogue may substitute alternative Virtues and has several Initiation Scripts for each.
quotes: Communication + Order of Hermes Lore vs. an Ease Factor of 15

entries.title: The Magic of the Titanoi (Commanding Spirits and Daimons)
entries.summary: Explains how Form and Mentem spells command spirits, and how a Daimon can send an Aspect to a magus who forms a pact with it through a ritual spell.
quotes: Spells of a specific Form can command any spirit tied to that Form, for example, Ignem can command any fiery spirit.

entries.title: Titanoi (Mystery Cult of House Tytalus)
entries.summary: Describes the Titanoi cult of spirit summoners: the Major Magical Focus in Spirits and Abilities taught in apprenticeship, and the Mystery Virtues the cult can initiate.
quotes: The cult can Initiate the following Virtues: Hermetic Theurgy, Invocation Magic, Names of Power, Theurgic Spirit Familiar, and Student of Magic Realm.

entries.title: Infernal Taint (Goetic Arts in the Titanoi)
entries.summary: Optional storyguide rule that the Titanoi mystagogues can also initiate the Goetic Arts as Major Mystery Virtues and teach Goetic Spell Mastery, with the social and supernatural taint that carries.
quotes: At the option of the storyguide, the Mystagogues of the Titanoi can also Initiate the Goetic Arts of Summoning, Ablating, Binding, and Commanding as Major Mystery Virtues, and teach Goetic Spell Mastery.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal, Chapter 11: Ars Goetia

entries.title: Structure of the Legion
entries.summary: How the Legion of Mithras is organised: underground temples in strong Magic auras, disciplined Auxiliary grogs and companions who support members, and ranks equivalent to degrees in other cults.
quotes: The Auxiliary Legion is open to faithful grogs and companions

entries.title: First Rank: Ravens
entries.summary: Initiation as a Raven requires an Ordeal oath giving a minor personality Flaw, followed by a season of training in the Virtue Strong-Willed.
quotes: the swearing of a magical oath that sears into the Initiates' being a new minor personality flaw: Dutybound (Legion of Mithras)

entries.title: Second Rank: Brides
entries.summary: Initiation as a Bride calls for a Quest to investigate a minor matter, then a season of tuition under the Lions in the Virtue Clear Thinker.
quotes: taught by a season of careful tuition under the Lions (high-ranking Initiates who reside at the temple) the Virtue Clear Thinker

entries.title: Third Rank: Soldiers
entries.summary: Initiation as a Soldier requires the candidate to lead a heroic Quest against a terrible enemy of the Order, followed by a third season of training in a warrior's Virtue.
quotes: the Virtue Reserves of Strength or Enduring Constitution

entries.title: Fourth Rank: Lions (Captain)
entries.summary: Initiation as a Lion needs repeated Quests including commanding Soldiers and Auxiliaries, teaches Inscription on the Soul, and requires seven years living at the temple, which grants an exceptional bonus to the next Initiation Total.
quotes: gaining a +5 bonus to their next Initiation Total, despite the normal limit on the bonus of +1 for time spent serving a Mystery Cult

entries.title: A Typical Raven Initiation Script (sidebar)
entries.summary: Worked example of an Initiation Script for the Raven rank: the Mystagogue's qualifications, the target level after a Minor Ordeal reduction, and the Quest and seasonal Sacrifice components with their bonuses.
quotes: the Target Level is 12 and an Initiation Script that grants a bonus of +5 is typically employed

entries.title: Fifth Rank: Persian
entries.summary: The top rank a player character is likely to reach; initiation calls for sacrificing the magus's talisman for a silver sickle replacement, and teaches the mystery of spirit familiars.
quotes: The Persian is always Initiated into the mystery of spirit familiars

entries.title: Typical Initiation Script for Philosophers of Rome (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar giving a worked Initiation Script for Hermetic Synthemata among the Philosophers: Mystagogue requirements, and the Script bonus built from sympathetic, wealth and time-sacrifice components.
quotes: The Script bonus is usually about +6 for this Initiation.

entries.title: The Structure of the Philosophers of Rome
entries.summary: Loosely organised congregations with no fixed degrees: new Initiates are first taught Hermetic Synthemata and usually Spell Binding, further Virtues of Hermetic theurgy go only to ambitious members, and ascension needs a supporting network of cultists with no known script.
quotes: All Initiates who are tutored by an existing cult Mystagogue are first taught the secret of the Virtue Hermetic Synthemata

related.text: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes

entries.title: Structure of the Children of Hermes
entries.summary: The Children of Hermes initiate by a missionary teaching Children of Hermes Lore for a season, then granting a Mystery Virtue and a copy of the Script; members owe yearly vis dues and recruit others in a pyramid. The cult assimilates other cults' Lore into its own Initiation Scripts.
quotes: She then becomes liable for the yearly dues that are paid in two or more pawns of vis

entries.title: Sample Initiation Script for the Children of Hermes (sidebar)
entries.summary: Sidebar giving a worked Script for the Major Supernatural Virtue Augury and Divination (ophiomancy) with a Quest, a season of study and sacrifice, and an Ordeal that bestows a Major Flaw; shows the large Script bonus needed with a weak Mystagogue.
quotes: the Initiation Script is designed to give a +14 bonus
The Initiate must be quite advanced in cult lore and possess a score of 6 to be Initiated into a Major Virtue.

entries.title: Fraternity of Samos: Structure and Entry Requirements
entries.summary: Describes the Pythagorean cult's strict degree system and its unusual mundane Ability prerequisites for a first Initiation, which also add a bonus to the Initiation Script.
quotes: it is required that the prospective probationer can pass examinations in philosophiae and artes liberales, which can be represented by having attained a score of 3 in both those abilities
represented by a score of 1 in Music
confer a +1 bonus to the Initiation Script employed

entries.title: Sample Initiation Script: Fraternity of Samos
entries.summary: Worked example of an Initiation Script for the first Samos degree, showing how a special bonus, a season of teaching and a Minor Ordeal Vow add up to the script bonus.
quotes: Initiation Scripts with a bonus of +7 are very common
for a total Initiation Script bonus of +7

entries.title: Samos Degree: Mathematicus
entries.summary: First Akousmatic degree; requires a minimum score in Artes Liberales (Mathematics) and teaches the Virtue Hermetic Numerology.
quotes: possessing at least a score of 3 in Artes Liberales (Mathematics)

entries.title: Samos Degree: Theoreticus
entries.summary: Second degree; requires a higher Artes Liberales (Geometry) score and a Numerologist's Book, and teaches the Virtue Hermetic Geometry.
quotes: possessing at least a score of 4 in Artes Liberales (Geometry)

entries.title: Samos Degree: Electus
entries.summary: Third degree; teaches Planetary Magic. The Initiators keep a natal chart and a permanent Arcane Connection to the Initiate, giving casters against the Initiate a Penetration bonus; this counts as an Ordeal.
quotes: a bonus of eight times Penetration score when casting spells against the Initiate
constitutes an Ordeal for Initiation

entries.title: Samos Inner Order: Mathematikoi
entries.summary: Describes the Inner Order's duties: minimum Teaching, hosting visitors, and training apprentices, which can serve as a Sacrifice in later Initiation Scripts.
quotes: Members of the Mathematikoi must possess the mundane ability Teaching at a score of at least 2
conferring a +6 bonus for the 15 seasons sacrificed

entries.title: Samos Degree: Tertius, or 3=4
entries.summary: Fourth degree; teaches the geometry of the elemental solids and the Virtue Hermetic Architecture, with other Virtues rumored.
quotes: the Virtue Hermetic Architecture is now Initiated

entries.title: Samos Degree: Secundus, or 2=5
entries.summary: Fifth degree; rumored to teach Inscription on the Soul, Hermetic Theurgy or Theurgic Spirit Familiar.
quotes: It is rumored that some Initiates learn the mystery of the Virtue Inscription on the Soul

entries.title: Samos Degree: Pythagorean, or True Initiate
entries.summary: Final degree; a five-year vow of silence counts as a Major Ordeal for Initiation Script purposes, and the Virtue taught is uncertain.
quotes: this counts as a Major Ordeal for Initiation Script purposes

entries.title: Sample Initiation Script: Disciples of the Worm
entries.summary: Worked example of the Spell Binding Initiation Script, itemizing season of work, tomb ordeal, teaching, offerings and sympathetic bonus.
quotes: a +9 Script is commonly employed to Initiate second degree disciples into the Mysteries of spell binding
for a total of +9

entries.title: Disciples of the Worm: Structure and Seven Degrees
entries.summary: Explains the cell organization of the cult and lists its seven degrees with the Virtue taught at each, from Second Sight to Living Ghost.
quotes: Initiates are divided into seven degrees

entries.title: Sample Initiation Script: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.summary: Worked example of the first Initiation of the Knights, with a Minor Ordeal that lowers the target level, a quest to the Castle, and a sacrifice for outfitting as a knight.
quotes: This Initiation Script confers a +7 bonus; it contains a Minor Ordeal that lowers the target level for this Initiation to 12
which creates the flaw Dutybound (+3)
entries.section: The Knights of the Green Stone

entries.title: Knights of the Green Stone: Structure and Degrees
entries.requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.summary: Describes the three degrees of the cult, the free Minor Status Virtue of knight role-playing, and the rules of membership.
quotes: The Knights divides its Initiates into three degrees, each of which offers up to three Initiations
entries.section: The Knights of the Green Stone

entries.title: Green Stone Degree: Page
entries.requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.summary: First degree; Initiations into Free Expression, Performance Magic: Music and Puissant Art of Memory.
quotes: The third Virtue taught is Puissant Art of Memory
entries.section: The Knights of the Green Stone

entries.title: Green Stone Degree: Squire
entries.requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.summary: Second degree; may confer Vulgar Alchemy, Hermetic Numerology and Consummate Talisman.
quotes: The Virtues Vulgar Alchemy, Hermetic Numerology, and Consummate Talisman can be conferred at this degree.
entries.section: The Knights of the Green Stone

entries.title: Green Stone Degree: Knight
entries.requires: Initiation: Knights of the Green Stone
entries.summary: Third degree; Virtues taught are Planetary Magic, a gemstone focus or Potent Magic, and Hermetic Synthemata.
quotes: They learn the Virtues Planetary Magic, Major Magical Focus: Gemstones or Potent Magic: Gemstones, and Hermetic Synthemata
entries.section: The Knights of the Green Stone

entries.title: Immortal Magi: General Rules
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Common rules for magi who have become immortal beings of the Magic realm: Might, no Aging, Warping or Twilight, and a natural reversion to stasis that must be countered by binding changes into a talisman.
quotes: An immortal ceases to make Aging rolls — he truly does not age — and is beyond the effects of Warping and Twilight.
A being with a Might score is subject to Warding spells, including Aegis of the Hearth

entries.title: Immortals: Permanent Change and the Talisman
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Explains how an immortal who keeps a talisman can bind learning into it, no longer limited in opening spaces by Technique and Form, and notes that Ordeals cannot be used for Initiation of immortals.
quotes: A maga who becomes immortal in one of these ways is no longer limited by her highest Technique and Form in the number of spaces she can open in her talisman
Ordeals cannot be used for Initiation of immortal beings

entries.title: Immortals: Learning Arts or Abilities
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Experience gained by an immortal fades over the next season unless a season is spent enchanting the talisman to bind it; includes a worked example.
quotes: The Effect level needed is 10 x XP to be retained.
She has a Creo Mentem lab total of 90, and can invest a level 45 effect in one season.

entries.title: Binding the Immortal Memory (Enchantment)
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Mystery enchantment guideline that binds a study period's experience into the talisman; the effect level required is tied to the experience points to retain and must be done in one season.
quotes: The Effect level needed is 10 x XP to be retained.
The effect must be completed in one season or all new experience points will be lost to the repair effect.

entries.title: Immortal Familiars: Extra Vis for Transformation
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes) with a familiar
entries.summary: A familiar can follow its magus into immortality if extra raw vis is added to the transformation rite; spirit familiars need none.
quotes: the magus must add extra raw vis to his transformation rite, equal to their Familiar Bond Score/5 (round up)

entries.title: Immortals: Learning Spells
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: A spell learned by an immortal fades from memory over the season unless bound into the talisman by enchantment.
quotes: The magus can bind the knowledge of a spell by creating an enchantment in his talisman.

entries.title: The Immortal's Grimoire (Enchantment)
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Mystery enchantment guideline that lets the talisman hold the knowledge of a spell as an always-on memory, so the spell is cast normally with full Casting Total and Penetration.
quotes: The invested effect level must equal the level of spell to be retained.
by casting the spell normally the magus uses his full Casting Total, gets full Penetration (Casting Total – Spell level + Penetration Bonus), and has unlimited uses per day

entries.title: Immortals: Binding High-Level Spells over Several Seasons
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Multi-season procedure alternating relearning a spell and investing it, with a Magic Theory roll to ensure the relearned spell matches and a botch table for failures.
quotes: He must succeed in a roll of Intelligence + Magic Theory against an Ease Factor of 6 + the magnitude of the spell.
To match each partial spell-binding, roll a stress die + Intelligence + Magic Theory vs. (6 + Magnitude of Spell).

entries.title: Immortals: Unchanging Nature, Healing and Mental Changes
entries.requires: Becoming an immortal magus (Great Elixir, Living Ghost or Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes)
entries.summary: Sidebar giving how temporary changes, wounds and mental effects fade for immortals, with weekly Recovery rolls, thresholds by wound level, and a table matching spell levels to healing rates.
quotes: Any Temporary, Unbound Change will Fade Completely over a Season.
Recovery Total: Simple Die + Stamina + Medic's Chirurgy or Medicine Score + Magical Aid
Improve if Recovery Total is 10+ (Light Wounds), 12+ (Medium Wounds), 15+ (Heavy Wounds)

gated.title: Bjornaer Mysteries
gated.intro: The Inner Mysteries of House Bjornaer.

entries.title: Ringing the Changes
entries.summary: Compares three kinds of shapechanger (spell or invested item, innate supernatural power, Heartbeast) and how each responds to Animal, Corpus and Mentem magic, Penetration and Warping.
quotes: The Heartbeast is the most total transformation of the three

alsoIn.title: Ringing the Changes (how magic affects shapechangers)

entries.title: Bjornaer: The Heartbeast
entries.requires: House Bjornaer: Initiation into the Heartbeast mystery
entries.summary: Bjornaer magi take the form of one mundane creature using the Heartbeast Ability; the form cannot be changed by Hermetic magic, they can cast in beast form at a penalty, cannot bind familiars, and gain little Warping from changing.
quotes: In that case, a roll of Stamina + Heartbeast against an Ease Factor set by the storyguide allows the character to change anyway.
As a rule of thumb, 3 + the magnitude of the transforming magic is a reasonable number.

entries.title: Secret Name (Minor House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer (Clan Ilfetu): Initiation of Secret Name
entries.summary: A minor House mystery that severs the sympathetic resonances of a magus's name: old Arcane Connections expire and Sympathetic Connections never work against him, though anyone who knows the secret name ignores spell level in Penetration.
quotes: All Arcane Connections to the magus which date from before the ritual immediately expire upon its completion, and all Sympathetic Connections become invalid.

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Synthemata Magic

entries.title: Initiation of Secret Name
entries.requires: House Bjornaer (Clan Ilfetu): Initiation of Secret Name
entries.summary: The initiation Ease Factor, script bonus and ritual details for the Secret Name mystery.
quotes: Ease Factor: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)
Script Bonus: +8

entries.title: The Mysteries of House Bjornaer (overview)
entries.summary: Overview of the layers of Bjornaer mystery, from the Outer Mystery of the Heartbeast to House, Clan and Inner Mysteries and the atavism that yields the inner heartbeast.

entries.title: Initiating the Clan Mysteries (Bjornaer)
entries.summary: Standard Initiation Ease Factor, Mystagogue requirement and the three Script templates (Trial, Deed, Oath) with their Script bonuses used by every Bjornaer clan to Initiate Clan Mysteries.
quotes: thus have an Ease Factor of 15
(Presence + House Bjornaer Lore) of at least 8

entries.title: Initiating the House Mysteries (Bjornaer)
entries.summary: House Mysteries (Heartbeast, Secret Name, Sensory Magic, Theriomorphy) are Initiated only by Clan Ilfetu, often at an ancestor site that may be perilous to reach.

entries.title: The Ritual of Twelve Years (Heartbeast initiation)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Heartbeast (Minor House Mystery)
entries.summary: The Initiation Script that grants the Heartbeast Virtue and Ability at level 1. It can never be repeated, its bonus depends on the temperaments of the witnesses, and it costs the ability to bind a familiar.
quotes: The Participation modifier provides +1 for every witness who has the same temperament as the probationer's heartbeast
Ease Factor: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)

entries.title: Theriomorphy (Minor House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Theriomorphy (Minor House Mystery)
entries.summary: Lets a magus apply Qualities or Virtues of his heartbeast to his human form with a roll, along with partial physical change and Warping consequences. Includes the Initiation Script.
quotes: on a Stamina + Heartbeast roll against an Ease Factor of 9
Script Bonus: +6

entries.title: Sensory Magic (Minor House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Sensory Magic (Minor House Mystery)
entries.summary: Special Targets that affect anyone sensing the caster, with the restrictions on these spells (Personal Range, no Intellego, no investing) and a Lab Total bonus from the Heartbeast Ability for inventing them.
quotes: the magus's Heartbeast Ability score is added to the Lab Total

entries.title: Sensory Targets
entries.summary: Defines the five Sensory Targets (Flavor, Texture, Scent, Sound, Spectacle), how each works and its Hermetic Target size equivalent, and gives the Initiation Script for Sensory Magic.
quotes: The Flavor Target is equivalent to Individual.
The Texture Target is equivalent to Part.
The Scent Target is equivalent to Group.
The Sound Target is equivalent to Structure.

related.text: ArM5 p.83 Words and Gestures table

entries.title: Initiating the Mysteries of the Inner Heartbeast
entries.requires: House Bjornaer, Virtue: Heartbeast, House Bjornaer Lore 5+
entries.summary: The Quest to find an ancestor who became a Great Beast and win Initiation into one of the three Inner Mysteries. It is gated by Adventure experience from the Great Beast's trials and a Major Ordeal, with a full Initiation Script.
quotes: the magus must earn a total of 10 Adventure experience points from these trials
Ease Factor: 21 (Major Virtue known to the Great Beast)

entries.title: Great Beasts as Mystagogues
entries.summary: Sidebar giving the Presence and House Bjornaer Lore to use for a Great Beast acting as Mystagogue, and stating that it knows whichever Inner Mystery is sought.
quotes: Great Beasts should be considered to have a Presence of +2 and an House Bjornaer Lore of 8.

entries.title: The Mystery of the Epitome (Major House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Mystery of the Epitome (Major House Mystery)
entries.summary: Perfects the heartbeast into a Beast of Virtue with a boosted Characteristic, a Mythic Feat usable at a Confidence cost, and immunity to shape-affecting Physical Flaws.
quotes: One Characteristic of the inner heartbeast (other than Intelligence) receives a permanent +3 bonus to the value of the base animal
at a cost of 1 confidence Point

entries.title: Sample Mythic Feats
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Mystery of the Epitome
entries.summary: Sidebar giving example Mythic Feats by Characteristic for an epitome inner heartbeast.
quotes: Lift something 20 times one's own weight

entries.title: The Mystery of the Chimera (Major House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Mystery of the Chimera (Major House Mystery)
entries.summary: Transforms the heartbeast into a hybrid of two creatures, with constraints on what can be combined and a Size increase for the chimerical form.
quotes: A chimerical heartbeast is one size category larger than the outer heartbeast

entries.title: Sample Elemental Forms
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Mystery of the Anima
entries.summary: Sidebar giving game effects for stone, air, fire and water elemental inner heartbeasts, as a basis for other elements.
quotes: His Soak receives a +15 bonus, but Quickness is reduced by 5.

entries.title: The Mystery of the Anima (Major House Mystery)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; Initiation: Mystery of the Anima (Major House Mystery)
entries.summary: Transforms the heartbeast into a spiritual or elemental creature of the same shape and size, affected by the Form associated with its element instead of Animal.

entries.title: The Inner Heartbeast in Play
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; any Inner Heartbeast Mystery
entries.summary: How to assume the inner heartbeast: change into the outer form first, then roll, taking a round. Reversing is automatic, and all features of the inner form apply together.
quotes: making a Stamina + Heartbeast roll against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Refining the Inner Heartbeast
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; any Inner Heartbeast Mystery
entries.summary: Introduces the smaller follow-on Initiations that change the Size, Characteristics, Qualities, Virtues or Powers of the inner heartbeast.

entries.title: Initiation of a Refinement
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; any Inner Heartbeast Mystery
entries.summary: The embryonic Initiation Script usable for any Refinement Mystery: a season at an ancestor site, vis consumed and a Resonant Bonus by inner-heartbeast type, with a storyguide sympathetic bonus when the Script is varied.
quotes: Script Bonus: +7 + Resonant Bonus
physically consuming one pawn of vis (of an appropriate Art) per three points of the Initiation Ease Factor

entries.title: Refinements (Inner Heartbeast)
entries.requires: House Bjornaer; any Inner Heartbeast Mystery
entries.summary: The available Refinements (Changing Size, Increasing Characteristic Scores, Acquiring Qualities, Virtues and Powers) with their Ease Factors, appropriate vis, and a worked example of Initiating each.
quotes: Ease Factor 18 + (3 per previous Size increase)
Ease Factor 18 + (3 per previous increase to this Characteristic)

entries.title: Structure of the Huntress
entries.requires: Esoteric cult: Huntress in the Wood
entries.summary: Overview of the cult's three ranks (kerykes, eumolpids, hierophants) and the Huntress in the Wood Lore Ability needed for Initiation.

entries.title: Kerykes (Huntress in the Wood)
entries.requires: Esoteric cult: Huntress in the Wood
entries.summary: The outer rank of the cult, which gives the Mystery of Nature Lore. Includes its Initiation Script (Huntress Lore 1, a gift of lore, and an Oath).
quotes: Script Bonus: +9

entries.title: Eumolpids (Huntress in the Wood)
entries.requires: Esoteric cult: Huntress in the Wood; Huntress Lore 3
entries.summary: The inner rank, which gives Hermetic Theurgy and can lead to Names of Power and Invocation Magic. Includes its Initiation Script with a supernatural mark that alienates the Initiate from the fae.
quotes: Script Bonus: +12

entries.title: Hierophants (Huntress in the Wood)
entries.requires: Esoteric cult: Huntress in the Wood
entries.summary: The leading rank of three, who gain Hermetic Synthemata and guard the Script for Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes. Gives both Initiation Scripts.
quotes: Script Bonus: +24
Ease Factor: 30 (Major Virtue unknown to the Mystagogue)

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition, Chapter 9: Hermetic Theurgy

entries.title: Criamon: The Enigma
entries.requires: House Criamon: Initiation into the Enigma
entries.summary: All Criamon magi have Enigmatic Wisdom 1 and may place experience in it at creation; the Ability helps comprehend Twilight but makes it more likely, and the House mysteries are divided into Paths.
quotes: All Criamon magi have a score of one in the Ability Enigmatic Wisdom, and may place experience points in it at character creation.

entries.title: Enigmatic Wisdom
entries.requires: House Criamon: Initiation into the Enigma
entries.summary: The Enigmatic Wisdom Ability adds to rolls to interpret dreams, riddles, phantasms and mysterious situations, and affects how often Criamon enter Twilight and how well they survive it.
quotes: Your score in this Ability is added to rolls to interpret dreams and riddles, and to understand phantasms and arcane or mysterious situations.

entries.title: The Path of the Body
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
entries.summary: Describes the Criamon Path of the Body, which focuses on the human form and treats the universe, like the body, as decaying.
quotes: The Path of the Body focuses on the human form.

versions.title: Path of the Body
versions.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
versions.summary: Introduces the Path of the Body, its five stations and the alternative order of the second and third stations, which changes the scripts and when the Pious Flaw is gained.
quotes: a Major Flaw (Pious) is always gained in the third avenue

entries.title: The Avenue of Subduing the Meat and the Station of the Perfect Tool
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
entries.summary: The first Station of the Path of the Body grants Minor Potency in an aspect of Corpus and lets the magus use Enigmatic Wisdom in place of Chirurgy and Medicine, at the cost of a Vow and Deleterious Circumstances when ill.
quotes: They may use their Enigmatic Wisdom score in place of Chirurgy and Medicine in rolls.

entries.title: Initiation of The Avenue of Subduing the Meat, Which Reaches the Station of the Perfect Tool
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
entries.summary: The initiation Ease Factor, script bonus and ordeal details for the first Station of the Path of the Body.
quotes: Ease Factor: 21, as Major Virtue
Script Bonus: +15

entries.title: Criamon Paths
entries.summary: Explains that Criamon magi follow spiritual paths of Mystery Virtues, that only one path may be followed at a time, and what is lost or kept when switching paths or following the Winding Path.
quotes: A magus may follow only one path at a time.
A magus who steps from his path to another begins without the use of any stations upon it, save Enigmatic Wisdom.

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition (discovering new Virtues)

entries.title: Enigmatic Wisdom and House Criamon Lore
entries.summary: Introduces House Criamon Lore, the Ability measuring a magus's understanding of the House's strategy, alongside Enigmatic Wisdom; House Lore gates progress along the stations.

entries.title: Guides and Mystagogues in Criamon Initiation
entries.summary: Describes how a guide fills the Mystagogue role in Criamon Initiations using the same numbers and formulae, and notes the Paths of the Mirror and Strife as exceptions with formal Initiation by superiors.

entries.title: Stations and Avenues
entries.summary: Each path has five stations reached by following an avenue, which requires a minimum House Criamon Lore, a trial or investiture, and an insight story; also sets assumed guide values for Initiation Script calculations and how Vow and Pious Flaws tie to path conduct.
quotes: The magus must have a House Criamon Lore score of at least one more than the station's position on the path, undergo a trial or ritual investiture, and find insight in a story.
The Initiation Script calculations given below for each avenue assume the guide's Presence + House Criamon Lore score equals 6.

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Initiation Scripts

entries.title: Psychodrama
entries.summary: Advice for running introspective avenue ordeals as allegorical stories inside the magus's mind; failure may block progress or force Twilight checks.
quotes: failure can force checks for Twilight

entries.title: Living the Path: Vow and Pious
entries.summary: A magus who lives against the path's lifestyle loses the associated powers until purity is restored; the Vow and Pious Flaws model this obligation.

entries.title: Enigmatic Wisdom for Criamon
entries.summary: Overview of Enigmatic Wisdom as the start of every path, trained by meditating on riddles and deepened by the insights of others.

entries.title: Symbolic Understanding
entries.summary: Criamon use Enigmatic Wisdom to read stigmata, detect Warping and interpret dreams and visions, with Ease Factors for how much they learn.
quotes: a successful Intelligence + Enigmatic Wisdom roll against an Ease Factor of 6
Perception + Enigmatic Wisdom roll against an Ease Factor six or more

entries.title: Labyrinth Meditations
entries.summary: A walking meditation in a labyrinth grants a bonus to one roll for an hour, with the meditation time and need for a physical maze shrinking as Enigmatic Wisdom rises.
quotes: The bonus is equal to half the magus's Enigmatic Wisdom score.
Labyrinth rituals take sixteen hours for characters with a score of one in Enigmatic Wisdom.

entries.title: Criamon and Twilight
entries.summary: Criamon magi are better at navigating Twilight, referring to the Twilight rules in the core book.

entries.title: Path of the Body Initiation Scripts
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
entries.summary: Initiation Script target levels, ordeals and script bonuses for each avenue of the Path of the Body.
quotes: Target level 21, as Major Virtue (Minor Potency in an aspect of Corpus, may use Enigmatic Wisdom in lieu of Medicine and Chirurgy)

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Initiation Scripts

entries.title: Station of Spiritual Nourishment
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
entries.summary: Initiates stop aging and need not eat, drink or sleep in suitable auras, but gain Warping and must meditate daily; the effect fails in some realms and auras.
quotes: Characters Initiated into this station gain a Warping Point each year, but do not age.
They must engage in elaborate, delightful labyrinth meditations that take six hours every day, but do not sleep.

entries.title: Station of Perfect Economy of Movement
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
entries.summary: Once a day after a labyrinth meditation the magus automatically succeeds at one Dexterity-related Ability roll up to a given Ease Factor; the Pious Flaw replaces the Vow.
quotes: the character automatically succeeds on single Dexterity-related Ability roll with an Ease Factor of 21 or less

entries.title: Station of the Microcosm
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
entries.summary: The magus may cast spells as if holding an Arcane Connection to any mundane place or thing he distinctly recalls, with an Intelligence roll against Ease Factors set by how familiar the place is.
quotes: Places that the magus has visited regularly require a roll against an Ease Factor of 6.
Places the magus visits yearly require rolls against an Ease Factor of 9.
Places the magus visited a long time ago require rolls against an Ease Factor of 12.

entries.title: Threshold of Corporeal Repose
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of the Body
entries.summary: Final station of the Path of the Body; the magus drinks representations of the four humors from legendary sites and gains a body purified of frailty that no longer ages.
quotes: The magus regains any attributes lost to aging and no longer uses the Aging Point system.

entries.title: Path of Seeming
entries.summary: Introduces the Path of Seeming, which looks for weak points in time by examining the world's distracting details.

entries.title: Path of Seeming Initiation Scripts
entries.summary: Initiation Script target levels, ordeals and script bonuses for each avenue of the Path of Seeming.
quotes: Target level 21: Package treated as a Major Virtue (Clear Thinker, Common Sense, and Keen Vision)

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Initiation Scripts

entries.title: Station of Differentiation of Seeming
entries.summary: First station of the Path of Seeming: the magus gains Clear Thinker, Common Sense and Keen Vision (or a similar sense Virtue) after a gruel-and-water investiture.
quotes: Each magus develops the Clear Thinker, Common Sense, and Keen Vision Virtues

entries.title: Station of True Sight
entries.summary: Second station: after a season of mad wanderings the magus can use Enigmatic Wisdom as both Second Sight and Magic Sensitivity and gains the Vow Flaw.
quotes: They may use their Enigmatic Wisdom score as if it were both the Second Sight and Magic Sensitivity Abilities.

entries.title: Station of Vivid Memories from Objects
entries.summary: The magus can recall an object's history by handling it, rolling Perception + Enigmatic Wisdom against Ease Factors based on how often the detail occurred, with a bonus for vivid events.
quotes: A magus seeking a particular memory makes a Perception + Enigmatic Wisdom roll.
Add +3 to the Perception + Enigmatic Wisdom roll for vivid events.

entries.title: Station of Passing Through Seeming
entries.summary: The magus sends his spirit travelling as a ghostly form that can see and speak at the destination and cast limited spells, while his body lies as if dead.
quotes: At their destination, they may cast spells at Arcane Connection range.

entries.title: Passing Through Rules
entries.summary: Spirit-travel total and the totals needed to reach familiar, previously visited, unknown and distant places.
quotes: A magus's Pass Through Seeming Total is a simple die + Intelligence + Enigmatic Wisdom + the magical aura of his destination.
hindered by an Aegis of the Hearth as if they were creatures with a Magic Might score of five times their Enigmatic Wisdom

entries.title: Station from Which to Ignore the Real
entries.summary: The magus can briefly treat solid mundane objects as spectral with a Stamina + Concentration roll, with the Ease Factor rising for more objects; the station also makes Twilight more likely.
quotes: With a Stamina + Concentration roll against an Ease Factor of six, and a round of preparation
The Ease Factor increases by one for every object after the first.

entries.title: Path of Strife
entries.summary: Introduces the Path of Strife, the House's worldly and morally transgressive path whose followers do sinful work on behalf of the House and hunt demons.

entries.title: Path of Strife Initiation Scripts
entries.summary: Initiation Script target levels, ordeals and script bonuses for each avenue of the Path of Strife, including the alternative first-station script for killing the Primus.
quotes: Target level 21: Treated as a Major Virtue (may sense magic and use a weapon with Enigmatic Wisdom score)

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Initiation Scripts

entries.title: Station of the Eater of Sin
entries.summary: First station: the magus senses strife, uses Enigmatic Wisdom as Magic Sensitivity without reducing Magic Resistance, gains the Blatant Gift, and uses Enigmatic Wisdom as a score for one weapon type.
quotes: They may use their Enigmatic Wisdom as the Magic Sensitivity Ability, but they do not subtract it from their Magic Resistance.
A magus on this path may use his Enigmatic Wisdom score as if it were a score for a single type of weapon.

entries.title: Station of Blood and Bronze
entries.summary: Meditation can rot or rust objects and kill mundane things in an area, and weapon strikes gain greatly increased Attack and Penetration; the magus can no longer enter Final Twilight.
quotes: They have four times the usual Attack Total, and can injure creatures immune to non-magical attacks.
This power's Penetration is (magus's Enigmatic Wisdom x 5), taking the Form of the weapon's striking edge.
which can be no wider than 500 feet across per level of Enigmatic Wisdom that the magus possesses

entries.title: Station That Repels and Attracts Elements
entries.summary: The magus can attract or repel objects of a single Form at will, limited by combined weight, with no Penetration and no effect on warded objects.
quotes: provided their combined weight does not exceed the magus's weight multiplied by three

entries.title: Station That Charms the Elements
entries.summary: The magus can talk to elementally pure objects and persuade their spirits to give information or move, using Presence + Charm rolls against Ease Factors set by the request.
quotes: With a Presence + Charm roll against an Ease Factor of 9 a magus can convince a spirit to give information, or to move in minor, useful ways.

entries.title: Station of Golden Cider
entries.summary: The magus strips supernatural properties from items, creatures and some Gifts by touch after a preparatory meditation, at the cost of losing Creo with most Forms.
quotes: the magus must have an Enigmatic Wisdom score at least one-fifth of the victim's Magic Resistance
this power has a Penetration score of (Enigmatic Wisdom x 5), with a Form of Corpus

entries.title: Repose on the Path of Strife
entries.summary: Followers of this path cannot enter Final Twilight and instead die creating adulterations, so many end their lives by using Golden Cider on themselves.

entries.title: Path of Walking Backwards
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of Walking Backwards
entries.summary: Introduces the Path of Walking Backwards and lets followers choose a reasoned labyrinth walk or an ecstatic dance; dancers use Dexterity for Enigmatic Wisdom rolls during labyrinth meditations.
quotes: Spinners and dancers use Dexterity rather than Intelligence when making Enigmatic Wisdom rolls during Labyrinth meditations

entries.title: Path of Walking Backwards Initiation Scripts
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of Walking Backwards
entries.summary: Initiation Script target levels, ordeals and script bonuses for each avenue of the Path of Walking Backwards.
quotes: Target level 21, Major Virtue (Gentle Gift) or elimination of Flaw (Blatant Gift)

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Initiation Scripts

entries.title: Station of Service to Harmony
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of Walking Backwards
entries.summary: First station: after purification under a Mystagogue the magus's Gift becomes Gentle, or a Blatant Gift is removed.
quotes: The Gift of most characters on this path becomes Gentle.

entries.title: Station of Rice and Honey
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of Walking Backwards
entries.summary: By labyrinth meditation the magus restores damaged objects to wholeness and can hold a dying person on the threshold of death for a limited time, but gains the Noncombatant Flaw.
quotes: This power has a Penetration score of the magus's Enigmatic Wisdom multiplied by five.
A magus may safely continue performing meditations for a number of hours equal to his Enigmatic Wisdom score.

entries.title: Station of Expression
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of Walking Backwards
entries.summary: The magus gains Free Expression and Inspirational, may use Enigmatic Wisdom as an artistic skill, and can convey complex ideas through artworks to mundane audiences.
quotes: Each magus who completes this avenue gains the Virtues Free Expression and Inspirational, and may use Enigmatic Wisdom in lieu of one artistic skill

entries.title: Station of Exaltation
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of Walking Backwards
entries.summary: By labyrinth meditation the magus draws out a latent positive property from a mundane object, with a difficult roll needed to know which will appear; the magus loses Perdo with most Forms.
quotes: an extremely difficult Intelligence + Enigmatic Wisdom roll (Ease Factor 21 or more)

entries.title: Threshold of Repose on the Path of Walking Backwards
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of Walking Backwards
entries.summary: The final station lets the magus freely change age, gender and species and choose the time of death, or ascend to join the Spharios.
quotes: A magus of this station may select his age, gender, and species as often as he wishes, taking only the time of a breath to change.

entries.title: Twilight and Walking Backwards
entries.requires: House Criamon: Path of Walking Backwards
entries.summary: The threshold of repose gives no Twilight immunity, though abstaining from magic and strong supernatural auras and avoiding multiple Warping Points at once avoids Twilight.
quotes: magi who abstain from all use of magic and stay out of powerful supernatural auras can avoid entering Twilight by avoiding gaining two or more Warping Points at once

gated.title: Merinita Mysteries
gated.intro: Faerie Magic, Becoming, Arcadian Travel and the other Mysteries of House Merinita.

entries.title: Merinita: Faerie Magic
entries.requires: House Merinita: Initiation into Faerie Magic (must be touched by the fay)
entries.summary: Merinita initiates are attuned to Magic and Faerie auras (no Warping or extra botch dice from either) and gain special Ranges, Durations and Targets (Road, Bargain, Fire, Until (Condition), Year + 1, Bloodline) usable only by Faerie Magic characters.
quotes: A character may not be Initiated into this mystery unless she has been touched by the fay.
To calculate the level of a Bargain spell, calculate the level of the spell that takes effect when the bargain is broken, and add three magnitudes.

entries.title: Faerie Magic Ability
entries.requires: House Merinita: Initiation into Faerie Magic
entries.summary: The Faerie Magic Ability can stand in for Magic Theory when experimenting or working with faerie vis, raises the vis usable in a season for faerie vis, and adds botch dice that cause Warping Points without forcing Twilight checks.
quotes: The amount of vis you can use in a single season is equal to your (Magic Theory + Faerie Magic) x 2, so long as all of it is faerie vis.

versions.title: Faerie Magic Ability
versions.summary: Arcane Ability gained by Merinita who Initiate Faerie Magic; it enables charms and can substitute for Magic Theory in some lab work with faerie vis, with its own vis limit and botch-dice effects.
quotes: Faerie Magic may be substituted for Magic Theory when experimenting, when using faerie vis, or when practicing magic associated with the Faerie realm.
The amount of vis you can use in a single season is equal to your (Magic Theory + Faerie Magic) x 2, so long as all of it is faerie vis.
Add your score in Faerie Magic to the number of botch dice you roll in these conditions

entries.title: Charms (Faerie Magic)
entries.requires: House Merinita: Initiation into Faerie Magic
entries.summary: Charms are sympathetic casting aids (objects, performances or pronouncements) made with an artistic roll that raise the Penetration Multiplier when the maga has an Arcane Connection; temporary charms are used once, permanent charms need a special object.
quotes: The maga produces an effective charm on a roll of 6+, or 9+ for a permanent charm.
increasing her Penetration Multiplier by two

entries.title: Mystery Cult: The Followers of Pendule
entries.requires: House Merinita: Followers of Pendule lineage
entries.summary: A Merinita lineage descended from the wizard Pendule whose followers usually Initiate Spell Timing and Glamour, favor Imaginem, and are weak to iron.
quotes: Followers of Pendule usually Initiate Spell Timing and Glamour

alsoIn.title: The Followers of Pendule (Spell Timing Initiation)

entries.title: Sample Followers of Pendule Initiation: Spell Timing
entries.requires: House Merinita: Followers of Pendule lineage
entries.summary: The Ease Factor, script bonus and ordeal for initiating the Spell Timing mystery, which brings three Minor Flaws.
quotes: Ease Factor: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)
Script Bonus: +12

entries.title: Spell Timing (Minor Illusion Mystery)
entries.summary: Gives access to new Durations (Held, Midday/Midnight, Season, While, Not, If) that hold, delay or trigger a spell, and to recurring spells that trigger repeatedly in response to a condition.
quotes: Held (Duration): This duration is the same level as Concentration.
To determine the level, you should add four magnitudes to the level calculated based on the Duration that the spell has when it takes effect

entries.title: Recurring Spells
entries.summary: Table of magnitudes added to a spell's level according to how often it recurs, from once a minute to once a decade.
quotes: Spells cannot recur more often than once per minute.

entries.title: House Merinita Society and Initiation Groups
entries.summary: Explains that House Merinita is one Mystery Cult made of many groups, that members first Initiate Faerie Magic, and that House Merinita Lore is needed to enter the Inner Mysteries.
quotes: must have at least House Merinita Lore 1 to proceed into the Inner Mysteries

entries.title: The Wayfarers (Arcadian Travel Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the Wayfarers cult, which teaches Arcadian Travel, and gives a worked sample Initiation Script with Ease Factor, script bonus and itemised script details.
quotes: Minor Virtue unknown to the Mystagogue

entries.title: Keepers of the Thousand Tales (Story Magic Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the Keepers cult, which Initiates Story Magic, Charm Magic and Becoming, with a worked sample Initiation Script for Story Magic.
quotes: Major Virtue known to the Mystagogue

entries.title: Faerie and Dreams
entries.summary: Magi with Arcadian Travel can open trods into a dream-based Arcadia, travelling in spirit while their sleeping bodies do not age or need food and water.
quotes: sleeping characters do not age or suffer ill effects of going without food or water

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition Dream Virtues

entries.title: The Shadow-Masters (Glamour Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the Shadow-Masters cult and its Great Play tournament, which Initiates Glamour, Animae Magic and Perpetuity, with a worked sample Initiation Script for Glamour.
quotes: Major Virtue known to the Mystagogue

entries.title: The Cult of Vesta (Nature Lore Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the Vestal cult, its two levels of Initiation (Vestal and the later Becoming or Guardian of Nature), the Lares Lore focus of Nature Lore, and a worked sample Initiation Script.
quotes: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)

entries.title: Merinita Mysteries and Schools
entries.summary: Explains that House Merinita Mysteries are grouped into schools, that Initiating the Outer Mystery counts as belonging to the House, and how lineages and groups provide Initiation.
quotes: They maintain that if you have Initiated the Outer Mystery, you belong to their House.

entries.title: House Merinita Lore
entries.summary: The Ability used to Initiate House Merinita Mysteries, with a minimum score to enter the Inner Mysteries and typical scores for Mystagogues.
quotes: Magi who wish to Initiate the Inner Mysteries should have at least a score of 1

entries.title: Enchanting a Faerie Familiar
entries.summary: Rules for binding a faerie being as a familiar, including the Shared Powers, Shared Senses and Shared Fatigue effects and the yearly decay of the cords.
quotes: Each Fatigue Level she spends is worth a number of Might Points equal to (familiar's Might Score / 5).
The familiar may regain (its Might Score / 5) Might Points by resting, just as the maga regain Fatigue Levels.

related.text: ArM5 p.104 Familiar Bonding Lab Total

entries.title: Temporary Familiars
entries.summary: A ritual that binds a supernatural creature as a familiar until a condition ends, with a minimum spell level based on the creature's Might and cords that begin at zero.
quotes: The level of the ritual must be no less than (the creature's Might + 15)
(Base effect, +1 Touch, +4 Until)

entries.title: The Three Faerie Cords
entries.summary: Three negative cords (Leaden, Iron, Tin) bought like the normal cords that balance the positive ones to stop decay, but impose penalties in certain circumstances.
quotes: so long as the sum of the values of one set of cords does not exceed the sum of the scores for the other, the cords do not degrade
add the value of this cord to the number of botch dice you must roll when the maga uses her powers in the Dominion or when touching a holy object

entries.title: Binding the Gift
entries.requires: Initiation: Binding the Gift (Minor House Mystery)
entries.summary: Shares the Gift's social effects with the familiar, and lets each familiar cord add to or penalise social rolls against particular types of beings.
quotes: In circumstances where more than one cord applies, use the one with the greater value.

entries.title: Arcadian Travel
entries.summary: Lets a maga open trods between the mortal world, regio levels and Arcadia using a charm and an Arcadian Travel Total compared to Ease Factors from a table; she can bring a limited number of companions.
quotes: Arcadian Travel Total: stress die + Perception + (Ability) + Aura
the Ease Factor is 12 for a mundane place, 15 for a regio level, and 18 if the destination is part of Arcadia
a trod can affect a number of other people equal to her Faerie Magic score

entries.title: The Line of Quendalon
entries.summary: Describes the lineage that Initiates the Arcadian Mysteries, with a worked sample Initiation Script for Animae Magic.
quotes: 21 (Major Virtue known to the Mystagogue)

entries.title: Animae Magic
entries.summary: Lets a maga transform objects into, or summon, temporary faeries called animae using new spell guidelines; animae can be targeted by the Form that matches their nature.

entries.title: Animae Spell Guidelines
entries.summary: New Creo and Muto spell guidelines, organised by Form, for creating faeries or transforming things into them; the faerie's Might adds to the spell level.
quotes: Since all faeries have Might, and since their Might is added to the level of the spell, Animae spells must always be designed at a level greater than that given in the guidelines.

entries.title: Becoming
entries.summary: A maga becomes a faerie through three lab rituals (Body, Mind, Spirit), each with its own level formula and Lab Total limit, then may use lesser transformation rituals; Ordeals reduce the required levels.
quotes: Becoming Lab Total Limit: Warping Score X Faerie Magic
Transforming the Body: (Character's Age – 35) + (5 x Decrepitude Score)
Transforming the Mind: Total Score in Abilities
Transforming the Spirit: Total Score in Arts
Faerie Might Score: Becoming Lab Total / 2

entries.title: Charm Magic
entries.summary: Lets a maga build charms into particular spells for Casting Total bonuses per charm and category, boost Penetration with an Arcane Connection, and combine concepts into one charm.
quotes: A single charm imparts a +2 bonus to the Casting Total of the spell.
Casting Total Bonus: +1 for each charm, +1 for each category represented
Sympathetic Connection Bonus: +2, +1 for each category beyond the first

entries.title: Charm Categories
entries.summary: The six categories of charm (adage, aspect, character, event, item, place) used to count category bonuses with Charm Magic.

entries.title: Story Magic
entries.summary: A maga designs story charms and spends a confidence Point to make the storyguide work the charm's concept into the narrative, or substitutes story charms as wild cards in Charm Magic spells.
quotes: Then she rolls the associated Characteristic + Ability against an Ease Factor of 9.
assume the character has a +3 bonus on all rolls associated with the charm for the entire scene

entries.title: Symbolic Magic
entries.summary: Lab activities using charms: charm bonuses to invested devices and talismans, permanent charms others can use, and ritual spells with Symbol Range, Duration and Target.
quotes: adding double the charm and category bonuses to her Lab Total instead of her Casting Total
this requires Faerie Magic 3 and a Characteristic + Ability roll against an Ease Factor of 12 to design the symbol

entries.title: Symbol Range, Duration and Target
entries.summary: New ritual-only Range, Duration and Target that use a symbol as an Arcane Connection, last as long as the symbol, or affect all targets the symbol represents.
quotes: It is the same level as Year, and requires a ritual to cast.
It is calculated at the same level as Boundary, though it is essentially a large Group

entries.title: Heirs to Merlin (Charm Magic Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the lineage that Initiates Charm Magic, Story Magic and later Symbolic Magic, with a worked sample Initiation Script for Charm Magic.
quotes: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)

entries.title: Glamour
entries.summary: Glamours are Muto or Creo Imaginem spells that behave as real things; this covers how they are resisted by Magic Resistance, seen through with Second Sight, and the Vulnerable Magic Flaw gained on Initiation.
quotes: Merinitae always gain the Vulnerable Magic Flaw when they Initiate this Mystery.

entries.title: Spell Glamours
entries.summary: Glamours that change another's spell into a different spell, following the Muto Vim restrictions; useful as countermagic but socially risky.
quotes: must be fast-cast, and must penetrate the spell's Penetration Total

entries.title: Perpetuity
entries.summary: Gives three ritual Durations (Might, aura, Hidden) that can last indefinitely under specified conditions.
quotes: All three are the same level as Year, and always require a ritual to cast.

entries.title: Nature Lore
entries.summary: A nature Arcane Ability tied to a type of nature that works as Area Lore at home, is reduced outside its region, lets the maga commune with nature, and is the basis for walking the path to gain further Virtues.
quotes: To represent this, always treat her score in Nature Lore as three less outside of her home region.
A Minor Flaw yields a Minor Virtue, and a Major Flaw grants a Major Virtue.

related.text: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal

entries.title: Sample Nature Lores
entries.summary: Table of example nature types (animal, water, weather, forest, desert, mountain) a maga can specialise in.

entries.title: Using Nature Lore
entries.summary: Scale describing what a maga can do at each Nature Lore score, from basic area knowledge up to commanding all the area's denizens.
quotes: Always treat a maga's score in Nature Lore as three less outside of her home region.

entries.title: Awakening
entries.summary: Lab procedure to awaken a natural spirit or animal using Nature Lore, with a total, effect level, vis cost, and optional powers invested using Might Points.
quotes: Awakening Total: Intelligence + Nature Lore + Technique + Form + Aura
Awakening Level: 25 + Might + (Size x 5), or (Aura + Size modifier) x 5
Awakening Cost: 1 pawn of vis per five levels or fraction
Power Cost: 1 Might Point per ten levels or fraction of the effect, minus 1 for every 5 pawns of (Technique or Form) vis

entries.title: Area Size Modifiers
entries.summary: Table of Size modifiers by area diameter used for Awakening and Guardian of Nature.
quotes: 100 paces in diameter

entries.title: Wilding
entries.summary: A season of work draws temporary vis from a wholly natural vessel matching the maga's Nature Lore; the vis must be used within days and only Wilding Initiates can use it.
quotes: Wilding: (Nature Lore x 2) pawns of (appropriate Form) vis

entries.title: Guardian of Nature
entries.requires: Initiation: Guardian of Nature (Major Nature Mystery)
entries.summary: A maga becomes a guardian spirit of an area (her locus) via a ritual with its own total, vis cost and level; the entry also covers her ghostly state, lack of aging, spellcasting limits and wounds to the locus.
quotes: Guardian Ritual Total: stress die + Presence + Nature Lore
Guardian Ritual Vis Cost: (level of the aura) pawns of (appropriate Form) vis
Guardian Ritual Level: level of the aura x Size modifier

entries.title: The True Merinitae (Wilding Initiation)
entries.summary: Describes the lineage that Initiates the nature Mysteries and gives a worked sample Initiation Script for Wilding.
quotes: 21 (Major Virtue known to the Mystagogue)

gated.title: Verditius Mysteries
gated.intro: Verditius magic, automata, Hubris and the other Mysteries of House Verditius.

entries.title: Verditius: Verditius Magic
entries.requires: House Verditius: Initiation into Verditius Magic
entries.summary: Verditius magi craft the item during its first season of enchanting, add Verditius Runes (their Philosophiae) to Shape and Material bonuses, add their Craft Ability to Lab Totals, reduce the vis needed to open the item, and need casting tools for Formulaic and Ritual spells.
quotes: a magus who does so may add his score in the relevant Craft Ability to all Lab Totals for enchanting that item
the number of pawns of vis needed to open the item for enchantment is reduced by the magus's Craft score, to a minimum of one pawn

entries.title: Hubris
entries.summary: The Hubris Personality Trait gained with a Verditius Inner Mystery, which grows with experience points from selling items, winning contests and vendettas, adds to certain enchanting Lab Totals, and must be resisted with opposed rolls.
quotes: A Verditius magus can add his Hubris score to his Lab Totals for creating a talisman, enchanting casting tools
you must make an opposed Personality Trait + stress die roll against an Ease Factor of your maga's Hubris score + her challenger's Hubris score

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.116

entries.title: Enchant Casting Tools
entries.requires: Initiation: Enchant Casting Tools (Verditius Minor House Mystery)
