entries.summary: A laboratory process to enchant casting tools to mirror mastered spell abilities and add casting bonuses, using a special Lab Total that must be double the effect level and costing Technique or Form vis.
quotes: ENCHANT CASTING TOOLS LAB TOTAL: Technique + Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura Modifier + Philosophiae + Hubris + Magnitude of Known Spell + Craft (if applicable)
The magus must spend one pawn of Technique or Form specific vis per 10 levels of the final effect level total, rounded up.

entries.title: Initiation of Enchant Casting Tools
entries.summary: The Ease Factor, script bonus and ordeal for initiating Enchant Casting Tools.
quotes: Ease Factor: 15 (Minor Virtue known to the Mystagogue)
Script Bonus: +9

entries.title: Initiation into the Mysteries of Verditius
entries.summary: How the general Mystery initiation rules are applied in House Verditius, including the Mystagogue's Initiation Total and the fact that the Outer Mystery needs no Verditius Cult Lore score.
quotes: Initiation Total = Presence + Verditius Cult Lore + Script bonus
A Verditius Initiate does not need a score in Verditius Cult Lore to be initiated into the Outer Mystery of the House.

entries.title: Verditius Initiation Scripts
entries.summary: The list of Script components specific to Verditius initiations (travel to a Forge, Quests, Ordeals, Sacrifices) and the bonus each one adds to the Initiation Total.
quotes: +6 The Initiate must perform a unique Quest
+3 The Initiate Sacrifices a lesser enchanted item whose combined powers are of at least the fourth magnitude.

entries.title: Verditius Cult Lore
entries.summary: Describes the Arcane Ability that holds the House's secrets, is raised like any Ability, and can be Trained as well as Taught by any member with a sufficient score.
quotes: Training allows every Verditius magus who has at least a Verditius Cult Lore score of 2 to instruct the lower Initiates in the House's secrets

entries.title: Outer Mystery of Verditius Magic
entries.summary: The initiation that every Verditius apprentice undergoes at the Forges of Hephaestus, granting the Verditius Magic Virtue, with its Target Level, Mystagogue requirement and Script bonus.
quotes: Mechanically, the Initiation Target Level is 15.
The Initiation Script has a bonus of +12

entries.title: Initiating Hermetic Magi into Verditius
entries.summary: The special ritual by which an already-Gauntleted magus of another House joins House Verditius: a probationary period, the Embrace of Boethius that forces reliance on casting tools, Warping, possible Twilight, and the traits and Virtue gained.
quotes: He also develops the Personality Trait Proud 1
He receives the Minor Hermetic Virtue Verditius Magic and gains a Reputation, Convert 1, in the House

entries.title: Learning the Inner Mysteries of Verditius
entries.summary: The Verditius Cult Lore scores a Mystagogue or Initiate needs at each stage (apprentice initiation, Minor Inner Mysteries, Major Inner Mysteries), and how self-initiation differs from learning from another member.
quotes: A magus must increase his score to 2 before Initiating an apprentice whose Arts he wants to open at the same time.
He should have a Verditius Cult Lore score of 5 before he is Initiated into any of the Major Inner Mysteries.

entries.title: Increasing Hubris
entries.summary: A table of behaviors (selling items, winning the Contest, learning Inner Mysteries, vendettas) and the experience points each adds to the Hubris score.
quotes: Winning the master category of the Contest. | 6 |
Selling an automaton. | 1/magnitude of Might |

entries.title: Verditius Ordeals
entries.summary: Sample Ordeals used to initiate Verditius Inner Mysteries (Sever the Ties That Bind, Self-Mutilation, Prone to Chance, Averse to Risk, Increased Hubris), each imposing a Flaw or personality change.
quotes: Each Ordeal may only be used once by a single magus.
The first Ordeal, undertaken to learn the first Minor Inner Mystery, always grants the Minor Flaw Hubris.

entries.title: Verditius Confraternities
entries.summary: Small sub-cults within the House that follow a set Mystery Path with a unique Inner Mystery; four examples (Roland, Balento, Irene the Younger, Himinis the Mad) give the path and a sample Initiation Script with Ease Factor and Script bonus.
quotes: these subsets of magi only contain four to eight followers at any given time

entries.title: Verditius Inner Mysteries Overview
entries.summary: Introduces the four Minor and four Major Inner Mysteries, which may be learned in any order, and explains that each comes with a sample Initiation Script at a standard Target Level that can be lowered by an earlier Ordeal.
quotes: There are four Minor and four Major Inner Mysteries of House Verditius.

entries.title: Items of Quality
entries.requires: Initiation: Items of Quality (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: How a Verditius magus draws out the latent Shape and Material bonus of an ordinary tool in one season for one pawn of Vim vis, giving a roll bonus capped by his Philosophiae; these are not true magic items for Magic Resistance or detection.
quotes: Items of quality are easy to make, and any Verditius maga who knows this Mystery may successfully create one in a single season.
this bonus is limited by the magus's Philosophiae score at the time of creation
Regardless of the bonus these items provide, they have a Lab Total of 10 if investigated.

related.text: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material bonuses

entries.title: Reforging Enchanted Items
entries.requires: Initiation: Reforging Enchanted Items (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: Overview of the Mystery that lets a magus repair, reforge or smelt enchanted items by rolling a Creo or Rego Vim Lab Total plus a stress die against the level of each power, one power at a time, over at least a season.
quotes: Creo or Rego Vim Lab Total + stress die vs. level of effect of a power of an enchanted device

entries.title: Repairing Enchanted Items
entries.requires: Initiation: Reforging Enchanted Items (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: Procedure for mending a broken enchanted item: a physical repair roll, then an Intellego Vim investigation of each power, then a Creo Vim roll to rebind each power, with Warping on botches.
quotes: You make a Dexterity + Craft stress roll against an Ease Factor of 9.
If a Verditius magus is accurately told the properties of an item, you may add +20 to your investigation rolls.

entries.title: Reforging Enchanted Devices
entries.requires: Initiation: Reforging Enchanted Items (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: How to re-craft a finished or merely opened device so it can hold extra vis beyond its normal limit, with the cost in vis, the penalty that raises later effect levels, and the results of failure and botches.
quotes: The reforged item can hold a number of pawns of additional vis equal to his score in Philosophiae at the time of the reforging.
The final instilled levels of effect of each of the reforged device's powers are increased by five times his Philosophiae score

related.text: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size table

entries.title: Smelting Enchanted Devices
entries.requires: Initiation: Reforging Enchanted Items (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: A season-long procedure that destroys an enchanted device to recover some of the vis used to make it, limited by Magic Theory and, with Elder Runes, Philosophiae, and with some vis always lost.
quotes: One pawn in ten is always lost, evaporating away during the smelting process.
either by his Magic Theory times two or, if he knows the Inner Mystery Verditius Elder Runes, by his Magic Theory times Philosophiae

entries.title: Verditius Elder Runes
entries.requires: Initiation: Verditius Elder Runes (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: Elder runes (a table linking each rune to an Art and a tree) that can be inscribed on an item to double an Art for enchanting at the cost of a higher effect level and vis, with a bonus for matching wood and a higher seasonal vis limit.
quotes: Each rune adds five to the final level of effect of the power being instilled in the device
each inscribed rune allows the magus to double the Art that the rune represents, exactly like a magical focus
It costs a pawn of Art-specific vis to inscribe each elder rune.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.26 (Minor Breakthroughs)

entries.title: Automata
entries.summary: Introduces the Major Mystery that grants the Craft Automata Ability and the three stages of building an automaton (body, spirit, mind); other Hermetic magi can learn it as a Supernatural Ability.
quotes: Knowing this Mystery grants the Major Hermetic Virtue Craft Automata, an Ability with an initial score of 1.

related.text: ArM5 p.166 Study Totals for Supernatural Abilities

entries.title: Creating an Automaton
entries.summary: Stage one of automaton construction: choose a species and material to get its Magic Might, pay a vis-equivalent cost in Mythic Pounds, and make an Intelligence + Craft Automata roll with a growing bonus after each failed season.
quotes: Magic MigHt: 10 + Size + Material Base Points
Intelligence + Craft Automata + stress die vs. Automaton's Magic Might

related.text: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size Table

entries.title: Preparing an Automaton for Enchantment
entries.summary: Stage two: opening the constructed automaton for enchantment by spending Vim vis equal to its Magic Might in a single season; the result is a greater enchanted item that cannot be a talisman.
quotes: This takes a number of pawns of Vim vis equal to the automaton's Magic Might score.

entries.title: Enchanting an Automaton
entries.summary: Stage three: instilling spell-like and Ability-like powers into an automaton, with fixed Range and Target, no Concentration Duration, a 'Cease' command, a vis limit equal to Magic Might, and a list of common automaton powers.
quotes: the maximum number of pawns an automaton can hold equals its Magic Might score
Each power instilled requires one pawn of vis for every ten levels of the power's final effect, rounded up.
This effect adds +3 to the final level of the effect.

entries.title: The Construction Combined (Tie the Threads That Bind)
entries.summary: The final step in making an automaton: casting the ritual Rego Vim spell Tie the Threads that Bind, whose level must exceed the automaton's Magic Might by a set margin.
quotes: This spell's level must equal or exceed the finished construct's Magic Might + 15.

entries.title: Automata in Play
entries.summary: How finished automata act (simple die only, no great successes or botches), the yearly maintenance roll against Magic Might, penalties from lost Might, and spot or seasonal repairs.
quotes: At the end of every year, roll a stress die and compare it to the automaton's Magic Might score.
Ease Factor of (6 + the magnitude of the automaton's Magic Might score)

entries.title: Bind Curse
entries.requires: Initiation: Bind Curse (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: How a magus binds Minor or Major Curses (Flaw-like maledictions that last seasons or years) into enchanted items: base effect levels, Range, Target and Duration, triggers, Penetration and vis cost.
quotes: The basic enchantment effect level of a Minor Curse is level 25, and the basic enchantment effect level of a Major Curse is 50.
Each conditional trigger adds +3 to the final level of effect of the Curse.
Minor Curses last a number of seasons equal to the item's creator's Magic Theory score at the time of enchantment.

entries.title: Minor Curses
entries.requires: Initiation: Bind Curse (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: A sample list of Minor Curses (weakened Characteristic, susceptibility to magic, twisted spine, warts, cataracts and more) with the game penalties each inflicts and the Arts used.
quotes: Hermetic magi suffer a –3 to their total Magic Resistance and must roll an additional botch die when botching using Hermetic magic.

entries.title: Major Curses
entries.requires: Initiation: Bind Curse (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: A sample list of Major Curses (Aging, leprosy, burning flesh, brittle bones, demon's visage, lust for life, doubt) with the rolls and penalties each imposes.
quotes: A broken bone is treated as a Heavy Wound and heals normally.

entries.title: Removing Curses
entries.requires: Initiation: Bind Curse (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: The ways a Curse can be lifted: waiting it out, a Perdo Vim spell matching its level, destroying or smelting the bestowing item (Minor Curses), or a powerful Magical or Divine creature.
quotes: The level of the Perdo Vim spell must match the final effect level of the Curse.

entries.title: Bind Magical Creatures
entries.requires: Initiation: Bind Magical Creatures (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: Lets a magus drain a magical creature's Magic Might as vis for a greater enchanted item, or permanently bind one of its powers to his Gift, with the Lab Total requirements, costs and permanent loss of Might; also covers Faerie Might and the risk of Warping.
quotes: For every point of Lab Total over the creature's Might score, the magus gains one pawn of vis that is usable toward the enchanted device.
the magus's Rego Vim Lab Total plus Hubris score must be equal to or exceed twice the creature's Magic Might.
Its Might is reduced by 5 times the Might cost necessary for the creature to use the power.

entries.title: Item Attunement
entries.requires: Initiation: Item Attunement (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
entries.summary: How a magus prepares a greater enchanted item like a talisman with a larger vis capacity, enchants it with his Hubris added to Lab Totals, then severs its link to him; also the Covet Device trait the item imposes on later owners.
quotes: The item can hold pawns of vis equal to his highest Technique + highest Form + Philosophiae score.
Compare his regular Perdo Vim Lab Total + a stress die to 10 + the maximum number of pawns of vis the device holds.
The device has a Covet Device Personality Trait equal to his Hubris score at the time of creation.

related.text: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size Table

gated.title: Legacies of legendary magi
gated.intro: Mysteries and discoveries left by the legendary magi of the Order.

entries.title: What the Order Remembers (recalling legendary magi)
entries.summary: A simple roll of Intelligence + Order of Hermes Lore tells a character how much of a legendary magus's story the Order remembers, graded by Ease Factor tiers from commonly known to lost secrets. House Acclaim or reputation can add bonuses, and some recollections may be false or restricted to a group.
quotes: make an Intelligence + Order of Hermes Lore simple roll and consult the following chart
The character recalls all relevant facts and rumors about that magus up to and including the Ease Factor they achieve.

entries.title: What the Order Remembers of Conciatta
entries.summary: The tiered list of what the Order knows about Conciatta (Known by All through Lost Secrets), with a House Acclaim bonus for Bonisagus characters; some entries are marked as distortions.
quotes: provides Bonisagus characters with a +3 bonus when rolling to remember about her

entries.title: Conciatta's Glossary (aura terminology)
entries.summary: Defines the Order's standard vocabulary for describing auras: diffuse, tethered, stable, waning, waxing, existential, moral, apparent and subsumed.
quotes: An aura with no fixed sustaining source.
The strongest aura present at a given location.

entries.title: New Spell Guidelines for Auras
entries.summary: Introduces new Intellego Vim and Rego Vim guidelines for detecting tethers and suppressing auras, usable by any maga who has studied at least one of Conciatta's unpublished works.

entries.title: New Intellego Vim Guidelines (tether detection)
entries.summary: Spell guideline levels for detecting the presence and strength of natural or supernatural tethers (the sources that feed an aura) and for detecting subsumed auras.
quotes: Detect the presence and strength of a supernatural tether of level 5 or higher.
Detect the presence of a subsumed aura.

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.10 tethers

entries.title: New Rego Vim Guidelines (suppressing auras)
entries.summary: A general Ritual guideline for suppressing an aura up to a given strength for the spell's duration, and what happens if the aura later grows beyond the ritual's power.
quotes: Suppress an aura of strength less than or equal to the spell's magnitude.

entries.title: Integration vs. Research
entries.summary: Explains the two ways to gain Conciatta's lost Virtues, integrating them through sources of insight or doing original research, and notes that research points from both approaches add together.
quotes: research points are cumulative with points gained by studying artifacts and texts

entries.title: Traversing the Regiones (seeing across aura and regio boundaries)
entries.summary: A worked example of the roll to see into a regio of a different realm from inside another aura, and how subsuming the surrounding aura changes the Ease Factor.
quotes: Perception + Second Sight simple roll against an Ease Factor of 5 + (2 x (2 + 6)) = 21
Perception + Second Sight simple roll against an Ease Factor of 5 + (2 x (6 – 1)) = 15

entries.title: Optional Rule: Swarms
entries.summary: An optional rule for treating a mass of tiny creatures as one swarm that ignores defenders, can attack several targets each round, may resist ordinary weapons, and retreats and returns rather than being easily destroyed.
quotes: A swarm is a mass of creatures of Size –3 or smaller with a combined Size of +1 or more.
Swarms ignore defenders and can always reach their intended target.
Swarms may attack a number of targets equal to the swarm's size each round.

entries.title: Confluence of the Realms (realm-swapping lab texts, vis extraction)
entries.requires: Virtue: Confluence of the Realms (Hermetic, researched or integrated)
entries.summary: Lets a maga change the realm named in a spell or device laboratory text when she uses it in the laboratory, and extract vis from any of the four realms using the usual extraction rules modified by aura. Explains the extended laboratory and vis rules behind the Virtue and its research-point cost.
quotes: can be changed during any subsequent use of that lab text
It takes 30 research points to integrate this Virtue.

entries.title: Insight of the Realms (Realm Lore in ceremonial totals, regio detection)
entries.requires: Virtue: Insight of the Realms (Hermetic, researched or integrated)
entries.summary: Lets a maga substitute the matching Realm Lore Ability for Artes Liberales or Philosophiae in ritual and ceremonial casting totals within or related to that realm, and use Realm Lore to detect and see through a regio boundary in place of Second Sight or Sense Holiness & Unholiness.
quotes: may substitute the appropriate Realm Lore Ability for either Artes Liberales or Philosophiae in any ritual or ceremonial spell totals cast within or related to the matching realm

entries.title: True Understanding of the Realms (reducing foreign aura levels)
entries.requires: Virtue: True Understanding of the Realms (Hermetic)
entries.summary: Her Realm Lore scores reduce the effective level of a foreign supernatural aura, lowering the realm interaction penalty, extra botch dice, and aura side effects, and also help the penetration of enchanted devices. Includes how it interacts with the sigil, talismans, and the cost to integrate, with a worked example.
quotes: the effective level of that aura is reduced by the score in the appropriate Realm Lore Ability to a minimum of 0
it takes 30 points to integrate or research this virtue, otherwise it takes 45 points.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.16

entries.title: The Constant Expression (Flaw with extended rules)
entries.requires: Flaw: The Constant Expression (gained when initiating Conciatta's Virtues)
entries.summary: A maga who perpetually casts minor non-fatiguing spontaneous effects can suppress them with a Concentration roll, must make further rolls to cast ceremonial or ritual magic with extra botch dice, and makes any laboratory she works in riskier.
quotes: making an initial Stamina + Concentration simple roll against Ease Factor 3 + (Warping Score)

entries.title: List of Artifacts (integration points for Conciatta's Virtues)
entries.requires: Studying Conciatta's artifacts and lab texts to integrate her Virtues
entries.summary: A table listing each spell or device found in the Four Corners story, which of Conciatta's Virtues it inspires, and how many integration or breakthrough points it provides.
quotes: the integration/breakthrough points that each provides

entries.title: History Unfolding (tempora and temporary Personality Traits)
entries.summary: Describes the rules for the Magic Realm vestiges, where non-Magical characters gain a temporary Personality Trait, and the Ease Factor for magical travel between them.
quotes: characters gain the specified temporary Personality Trait of +3 while they remain within the tempus
each vestige has a level of 5, for an Ease Factor of 15 to travel to the next tempus

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.23 Magical Travel

entries.title: Insight from Conciatta's devices and laboratory texts
entries.summary: Explains that each noted laboratory text or device gives a bonus to the insight roll equal to the effect's magnitude, and that only the highest-level effect on a multi-effect device provides insight.
quotes: equal to the magnitude of the effect. Where a device is enchanted with more than one effect, only the highest level effect provides insight.

entries.title: Aftermath: further Hermetic Breakthroughs from Conciatta's work
entries.summary: Describes the next possible Hermetic Breakthrough, letting Vim spells affect every realm without re-invention, and how owning Conciatta's Virtues lowers it to a Major Breakthrough, plus a further Major Breakthrough to fully integrate her work for all magi.
quotes: possession of Conciatta's Virtues lays the groundwork and, with troupe approval, reduces this level of integration to a Major Breakthrough

entries.title: Bonisagus House Acclaim (Conciatta's Virtues)
entries.summary: States how many House Acclaim points a Bonisagus magus earns for rediscovering each of Conciatta's Virtues.
quotes: rediscovering Conciatta's Minor Virtues awards 15 acclaim points each

entries.title: What the Order Remembers of Fortunata
entries.summary: The tiered list of what the Order knows about Fortunata (Known by All through Uncommon Knowledge), with notes that some items are known only to Redcaps or Jerbiton magi and that some legends are false.
quotes: See the Introduction for details on revealing the legend of Fortunata.

entries.title: Temporary Laboratories
entries.summary: A reminder of what it takes to build a Basic Laboratory quickly for a single task, with a penalty to Lab Totals, and where to find fuller laboratory rules.
quotes: imposes a -3 penalty to all Lab Totals

entries.title: Spells to Summon and Command Spirits (guidelines)
entries.summary: Reprints the Rego Mentem guidelines for controlling and summoning a disembodied spirit of a given Form.
quotes: Control a disembodied spirit of (Form).
Summon a disembodied spirit of (Form).

entries.title: Fortunata's Initiations (Initiation Scripts and Quests)
entries.summary: Explains that Fortunata's written Initiation Scripts each contain Quests the Initiate must lead, how others may help or oppose, and that the Quests are only outlined as story seeds for the saga to refine.
quotes: Each of the Initiation Scripts includes one or more Quests which the Initiate must perform.

entries.title: Principles Lore (Fortunata's Organization Lore)
entries.requires: Study of Fortunata's Principles Lore texts
entries.summary: Principles Lore is an invented Organization Lore that serves as the Cult Lore for Fortunata's Initiation Scripts without any actual cult; it imposes no ranks, earlier scripts give higher Script Bonuses, and some scripts are ordered to follow a prior Ordeal.
quotes: Knowledge of this constitutes an "Organization Lore" in game terms, and acts as the "Cult Lore" for a set of Initiations with no actual cult.
Fortunata's "Cult" imposes no ranks, hierarchy or sequence of Initiations.

related.text: The Mysteries: Revised Edition p.87 Hermetic Synthemata

entries.title: How To Use A Script With No Cult
entries.summary: Explains that a magus can Initiate himself or another using an Organization Lore as the cult lore, using his own Presence, and that troupe approval is needed to repurpose an existing organization for Mysteries.
quotes: A magus can Initiate himself as easily as he can Initiate another into a Virtue he, as Mystagogue, lacks.
Each (Mystery Cult) Lore is an instance of (Organization) Lore

entries.title: Borrowing Cult Lore and Initiation Scripts (Practice Source Quality)
entries.summary: Gives the Practice Source Quality for a season spent practicing a Cult Lore, and a higher quality when the practice is inspired by another cult's ancient lore text the troupe judges compatible.
quotes: A season dedicated to Practice Cult Lore = Quality 4
A season of Practice Cult Lore inspired by ancient lore = Practice Source Quality 5

entries.title: Adapting Scripts (understanding and modifying another cult's script)
entries.requires: Mystery Cult membership and a foreign Initiation Script
entries.summary: Describes studying another cult's Initiation Script for about a week, rolling to understand it, and rolling again to modify it as if changing a script component; a botch gives a false script.
quotes: To Understand Another Cult's Script: Intelligence + (other Cult) Lore vs. 9
To Modify the Script, Change a Script Component: Intelligence + (own Cult) Lore vs. 12

entries.title: Initiation Mechanics (summary)
entries.summary: A brief summary of the Initiation process: the Mystagogue's Initiation Total is compared to a Target Level with no die roll, with different Target Levels for Minor or Major Virtues known or unknown, reductions after an Ordeal, and rules for self-initiation.
quotes: Initiation Total: Presence + (Mystery Cult) Lore + Script Bonus
To Initiate a Minor Virtue known by the Mystagogue: Target Level is 15
To Initiate a Major Virtue NOT known by the Mystagogue: Target Level is 30

entries.title: The Need To Vary A Script To Increase The Bonus
entries.requires: Mystagogue with an existing Initiation Script
entries.summary: A Mystagogue can extend an Initiation Script with a further Quest to raise its Script Bonus by passing an Intelligence + Cult Lore test.
quotes: To add a further Quest (+3 Script Bonus) to an existing Initiation Script, the Mystagogue must succeed in a test of Intelligence + (Mystery Cult) Lore against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Keeping Track Of Ordeals & The Previous-Ordeal Bonus
entries.summary: Reminds the player to record each Ordeal suffered, because it gives a Script Bonus to its own Initiation and lowers the required Initiation Total for the next three Initiations.
quotes: reduce the Initiation Total required for the next three Initiations, no matter what they are

entries.title: Multiple or Overlapping Scripts
entries.summary: When scripts share Quests or Ordeals that a self-initiate has already performed, the new script must be changed, with rolls for modifying or replacing an element; Ordeals are rarely repeatable while sacrifices are easier to repeat.
quotes: Modifying a script requires a roll of Intelligence + Cult Lore against an Ease Factor of 12; replacing a script element by a different one has an Ease factor of 15.

entries.title: Initiation of Puissant Principles Lore
entries.summary: Fortunata's script for gaining Puissant Principles Lore, with its Quests, Vow, vis sacrifice and the Initiation Total and Script Bonus breakdown.
quotes: Initiation Total 18, Script Bonus 16

entries.title: Initiation of Spirit Familiar
entries.summary: Fortunata's adapted Greek script for gaining the Spirit Familiar Virtue, built around Quests to rescue the spirit and defeat its enemy and a place and time of significance.
quotes: Initiation Total 18, Script Bonus 12

entries.title: Virtue: Spirit Familiar (bonding and cords)
entries.summary: Explains how to bind a spirit familiar, the bonding level formula for an insubstantial spirit, the renamed Hermes, Isis and Hekate cords, and how the spirit's Might-based Magic Resistance interacts with Parma Magica.
quotes: Spirit Familiar Bonding level: Spirit's Might + 25

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic ch.7 Magic Spirits

entries.title: Initiation of Minor Magical Focus (commanding spirits)
entries.requires: Initiation Script: Minor Magical Focus (commanding spirits)
entries.summary: Script for the Minor Magical Focus covering Rego spells that command spirits, which involves an Ordeal imposing the Necessary Condition Flaw of speaking spirit names.
quotes: Initiation Total 18, Script Bonus 12

entries.title: Speaking the Names of Spirits (Necessary Condition)
entries.requires: Necessary Condition from the Minor Magical Focus Ordeal
entries.summary: Describes the practical effect of the condition (spells must be cast aloud, with recognizable invocations) and how the Ordeal detail can be varied, with an Intelligence + Principles Lore roll.
quotes: requires an Intelligence + Principles Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 12

entries.title: Initiation of Major Magical Focus (spirit magic)
entries.requires: Initiation Script: Major Magical Focus (spirit magic); an existing Minor Magical Focus
entries.summary: Script converting a Minor Magical Focus into a Major Focus in spirit magic through defeating two strong spirits, relying on the Ordeal reduction from the earlier script.
quotes: Initiation Total 21 (30 – 9 for previous Ordeal), Script Bonus 13

entries.title: Splitting Major Virtue Initiations
entries.summary: Explains the technique of gaining a Major Virtue in two stages, with an Ordeal in a preliminary Minor Virtue Initiation that lowers the Initiation Total needed for the second.
quotes: reduces the Initiation Total needed for the Major Virtue, rather than increasing the Script Bonus

entries.title: Initiation of Spell Binding
entries.summary: Fortunata's script for the Spell Binding Virtue, involving forcing a spirit into a glass ball to sustain a light spell in a deep cave.
quotes: Initiation Total 12 (18 – 6 for previous Ordeal), Script Bonus 6

entries.title: Virtue: Spell Binding (spirit-sustained spells)
entries.summary: A Ritual spell guideline combines a second spell with a bound spirit in a physical container so the second spell is maintained indefinitely while the spirit remains bound.
quotes: the spirit's Might must at least equal the sustained spell's level

entries.title: Sustain a Spell of (Form)
entries.summary: The General ReVi Ritual guideline that entwines another spell with a container so a bound spirit of sufficient Might sustains it indefinitely.
quotes: The base level of this spell must equal or exceed the level of the spell to be sustained.

entries.title: Initiation of Hermetic Empowerment
entries.summary: Fortunata's script for Hermetic Empowerment, in which a device is enchanted in a graveyard with vis from destroyed ghosts and then burned at a pyre on a quarter-day.
quotes: Initiation Total 18, Script Bonus 9

entries.title: Virtue: Hermetic Empowerment (spirit-powered Ritual effects)
entries.summary: Lets a magus enchant Ritual effects into a device powered by a bound spirit, whose permanent Might is drained with each use and which limits the effect level.
quotes: The Effect Level cannot exceed twice the spirit's Might Score, so the spirit cannot be completely drained.

entries.title: Empowering Prison of the Declining Spirit
entries.summary: The Mystery enchantment guideline that binds a spirit in a device to power Ritual effects, with requisites of the Forms involved and a base level tied to the spirit's Might.
quotes: The base level of the enchantment must equal or exceed twice the Might of the spirit that will be bound

entries.title: Bound Spirits (command spells made permanent; countermanding bindings)
entries.summary: A worked example of using Spell Binding to make a command spell permanent, which cheaply keeps a spirit bound and lets the container grant command. It also states what is needed to countermand an existing command effect or end a binding by breaking the container.
quotes: a countermanding spell must exceed the level of the original, and also penetrate the Magic Resistance of the spirit

entries.title: What the Order Remembers of Hérisson
entries.summary: The tiered list of what the Order knows about Hérisson, with a roll bonus for Bjornaer magi and a larger bonus for members of Clan Arelie.
quotes: receive a +1 bonus to their roll; members of Clan Arelie
receive a +3 bonus instead

entries.title: Lesser Enchantment Vis and Spell-Like Vis
entries.summary: Reminder sidebar on two special kinds of vis: Lesser Enchantment Vis keeps a standing enchantment while unused, and Spell-Like Vis fires one spell (possibly a ritual) and is then expended.
quotes: Lesser Enchantment Vis emulates a Lesser Enchantment, usually of level 30 or less.
Spell-Like Vis has a single use only, mimicking the effects of a spell of up to 60th level

entries.title: Labor Points (sidebar)
entries.summary: Defines Labor Points as a measure of a worker's day-to-day output in seasons spent earning Exposure, how many are needed per year to keep a business or crop going, and how a foreman can pool workers' points.
quotes: An individual must accumulate 36 Labor Points in a year to maintain his business or grow his crops.
he accumulates a number of Labor Points equal to three times his Communication + Profession Ability, or his Dexterity + Craft Ability

entries.title: Warped Plants
entries.summary: Rules for Warping in plants: short-lived plants escape it, while older perennials and trees gain Minor Flaws (and Virtues) from warping, with common Flaw examples.
quotes: Annual and biennial plants escape such effects by virtue of their short lifespans, but perennial plants that are five years or older possess a Minor Flaw from warping

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.78 Warping of animals

entries.title: Hermetic Viresculture (overview)
entries.summary: Explains Hérisson's breakthrough that lets magi grow self-replicating vis (Stirpes) rather than only harvest static vis (Grana); a Stirps must first be Vitalized and then Invigorated.
quotes: Grana (singular Granum), which is ordinary, static vis; and Stirpes (singular Stirps), which is self-replicating vis

entries.title: New Supernatural Ability: Hermetic Viresculture
entries.summary: Describes the Hermetic Viresculture Ability, which lets a character produce self-reproducing vis and cultivate vis as magical agriculture; it can be taught to magi and only works for those opened to the Hermetic Arts.
quotes: Only those opened to the Hermetic Arts can make use of this Ability since it relies on Hermetic magic.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.29

entries.title: The Stirps
entries.summary: Defines the Stirps, the first individual of a cultivar that holds usable vis and can reproduce; usually a living being, though even a small fire elemental can serve.
quotes: This is the first individual that both contains usable vis and is capable of reproduction, and is the founder of a given cultivar

entries.title: Vitalizing Vis
entries.summary: Laboratory activity, akin to creating an invested device, that turns a living magical creature or plant into a Stirps. Accumulate seasonal points against a target Level based on its Magic Might; it also lets vis be removed from a living donor without killing it.
quotes: Vitalization Total: Intelligence + Creo + Vim + Hermetic Viresculture + Aura Modifier
Level of Effect: Magic Might
Vitalization costs one pawns of Vim vis per ten points of the Level of Effect (or fraction thereof)

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.62 Raven of Virtue

entries.title: Stirpes from Lesser Enchantment Vis
entries.summary: Lesser Enchantment Vis found in a self-reproducing living form can be Vitalized into a Stirps, using the level of its effect in place of Magic Might. Viresculture cannot create such vis, only let it propagate.
quotes: instead of Magic Might, use the level of the effect possessed by the vis

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.119 Lesser Enchantment Vis
Realms of Power: Magic p.124 Enriched Things of Virtue

entries.title: New Cultivars (sidebar)
entries.summary: Suggests further raw materials for Stirpes, such as gemstones that reproduce, elementals for the elemental Forms, and (impractically) Magic Humans.

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.83 Magic Humans

entries.title: Invigorating a Stirps
entries.summary: One-season laboratory activity that lets a Stirps produce vis-bearing offspring for a number of breeding seasons, with a set yield of vis pawns per litter or crop and a chance that a pawn is itself an uninvigorated Stirps.
quotes: Invigoration Total: Intelligence + Creo + Form (Vim Requisite) + Hermetic Viresculture + Aura Modifier
Breeding Seasons: Invigoration Total / 10, rounded up
Number of Pawns of vis produced: (Magic Might/5) or (Level of Effect/5), rounded up

entries.title: Growing and Harvesting Vis
entries.summary: Describes harvesting pawns of vis from an Invigorated Stirps each breeding season, how its offspring are born Vitalized but uninvigorated, and how Stirps vis can be told apart with Intellego Vim.
quotes: All Stirpes born to a Stirps are naturally Vitalized but uninvigorated.

entries.title: Caring for Vis
entries.summary: Upkeep rules for an Invigorated Stirps: it must be kept in a magical Aura, the magus can supervise only a limited number of Stirpes, neglect or too little labor cuts the yield, and each Stirps needs a set amount of Labor Points.
quotes: A magus can only oversee the growth of a number of Stirpes (of any cultivar) equal to his Hermetic Viresculture Score.
It costs 12 Labor Points to care for each Stirps and its associated plants or animals.
Maximum Number of Stirpes fertile in a generation: Hermetic Viresculture

entries.title: Weakening an Aura Through Hermetic Viresculture
entries.summary: Optional interaction with Aura Variation: pawns harvested through Viresculture lower the Yearly Aura Modifier of the aura they grew in.
quotes: Yearly Aura Modifier for Viresculture: – (total pawns / 5)

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.10 Aura Variation

entries.title: Caerfloron's Magical Tradition (Homunculus Wizards)
entries.summary: Describes the magi of Caerfloron as Homunculus Wizards whose magic comes from a manikin made of a Mandrake of Virtue, listing the Virtues and Flaws their tradition grants and the plant-like way they sustain themselves.
quotes: Their magical tradition grants them the Greater Immunity to Deprivation and Faerie Magic Virtues, and the Homunculus Wizard Flaw.

entries.title: The Garden as a Source of Breakthrough
entries.summary: Explains how magi can recreate Hérisson's Breakthroughs by studying his surviving inventions as Insight sources, using Hermetic Investigation in place of a Magic Theory roll and earning Breakthrough points by duplicating the effects; Stirpes count as level 15 enchantments.
quotes: Each Stirps should be considered to be an enchantment of Level 15
earning Breakthrough points equal to the magnitude of the effect created

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.26 Original Research
ArM5 p.162 Gather the Essence of the Beast

entries.title: The Garden as a Source of Study
entries.summary: Treats the garden's plants as realia for study in Herbam, and its Stirpes as realia of Hermetic Viresculture, each with a Source Quality and a limited number of uses.
quotes: a magus generates a Source Quality of 6, and can study from the garden six times in total

entries.title: The Garden as an Hermetic Laboratory
entries.summary: Gives the garden's laboratory statistics (Virtues, Flaws, Characteristics, Specializations) and the rule that a season's equipment and ingredients are only available if a simple die roll comes in under the lab's Warping Characteristic.
quotes: If it is under the Laboratory's Warping Characteristic, then the equipment and ingredients for that activity are available and the season can progress as planned

related.text: Covenants p.118 Taking Over a Laboratory

entries.title: Laboratory Texts from the Garden (sidebar)
entries.summary: Optional rule that Hérisson's laboratory texts for his Original Research yield Breakthrough points when studied by recreating the experiment.
quotes: Each of his Hermetic creations provides Breakthrough Points equal to the magnitude of the effect once it has been studied by recreating the experiment

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.29

entries.title: Journeying Underwater
entries.summary: Covers the difficulties of moving, fighting, seeing, casting and descending underwater: slow swimming, weapons and trained groups that stop working, blurred vision, restricted spellcasting, and pressure that drains Fatigue levels with depth.
quotes: Characters who know how to swim will travel by swimming at half the speed that a typical person walks.
After each 10 paces of descent, a character loses one-tenth of his current depth minus soak (extra soak from armor does not apply), in fatigue levels.

related.text: ArM5 p.122 Lungs of the Fish

entries.title: Rego Vim Guidelines (activating enchanted devices)
entries.summary: New Rego Vim guideline letting a spell trigger an enchanted device that has a simple trigger, provided the caster knows the triggering action; linked and environmental triggers are excluded.
quotes: Activate an enchanted device with a simple trigger (i.e., not a linked trigger or an environmental trigger, see

entries.title: A Note on Warping by Enchanted Devices
entries.summary: Clarifies that level modifications such as Penetration, uses per day and triggers are not counted when working out whether an enchanted effect warps its targets.
quotes: Modifications to the level of an effect—including Penetration, effect frequency, environmental trigger, linked trigger and effect use—are not used to determine whether or not an effect causes warping to its targets through the power of the magical effect.

entries.title: Sentinels and Justiciars (Herald of Imperative)
entries.requires: Coeris sentinel and justiciar design (Laboratory of Hermanus)
entries.summary: Describes a defensive device pattern in which sentinel items detect intruders with Intellego effects and fire a Herald of Imperative enchantment that activates justiciar items to trap them, all keyed to one pre-set triggering action.
quotes: In the plans of Hermanus, a sentinel item's Intellego spell would detect an intruder and the item would activate the Herald of Imperative enchantment.

entries.title: A Note on Boundary Effects
entries.summary: Points out that Boundary-range effects such as an Aegis of the Hearth or a ward cannot travel with a moving structure like a flying castle and are left behind.
quotes: Boundary effects are not, by their nature, mobile.

gated.title: The Paths through the Forest
gated.intro: The solitary forest paths of the Rhine: Forest Lore, Sacrifices, Quests and Fruits.

entries.title: The Paths Through the Forest
entries.requires: Forest Lore; communion with a genius locus
entries.summary: Introduces the idea of walking solitary paths to the primal power of the forests, which can overcome Lesser Limits of Hermetic magic but is dangerous and has no teacher except in a few cases.
quotes: each path must be walked alone, and it is easy to become lost

entries.title: The First Step: Gaining Forest Lore
entries.requires: Spending time in a supernatural forest
entries.summary: The first step on a forest path is spending time in a supernatural forest to learn the Forest Lore Ability, using the aura as Source Quality, which can happen without the character knowing it.
quotes: the Source Quality is the strength of the aura in which the student spends most of his time
Once this Ability reaches a score of at least 1, the character has reached the level of understanding which will allow him to find the path that he wishes to travel.

entries.title: Walking the Path: Communion, Sacrifice and Fruit
entries.summary: How a character finds a path and enters communion with a genius locus, forming a pact in game terms: a Flaw (the Sacrifice) is taken first and, after a Quest, a Virtue (the Fruit) is gained to balance it.
quotes: Intelligence + Forest Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 9, one attempt per season
In game terms, at the conclusion of the communion, the character will acquire a Flaw (termed the Sacrifice).

entries.title: New Arcane Ability: Forest Lore
entries.requires: Arcane Ability; learned in a supernatural forest
entries.summary: Defines the Forest Lore Arcane Ability, its scope for home and foreign forests, how it is advanced, and a table of what each score of understanding allows.
quotes: Forest Lore can only be increased through practice, and the Source Quality is always equal to the strength of the forest's aura.
For example, a score of 4 (instead of 1) is required to enter communion with a foreign genius locus.

related.text: Walking the Path: Communion, Sacrifice and Fruit

entries.title: Sacrifices on the Forest Paths
entries.requires: Forest Lore; communion with a genius locus
entries.summary: Guidance for choosing the Flaw taken as the Sacrifice of a forest path, with typical examples and a reminder that it needs the player's consent.
quotes: Sacrifices are not a manifestation of a forest spirit's Grant Flaw power, but instead permanent changes to those who take them on.

entries.title: Quests on the Forest Paths
entries.requires: Forest Lore; communion with a genius locus
entries.summary: Explains that a Quest is a task with a clear end set by the genius locus to earn a Fruit, that the questing character gains no experience from it, and how Major quests compare with Minor ones.
quotes: A character undertaking a Quest will not gain any experience points for doing so
Quests for a Minor Virtue typically take no more than two seasons.

entries.title: Fruits of the Forest Paths
entries.summary: Explains that a Fruit is a permanent supernatural effect, usually a Virtue that unGifted characters can also gain, and advises storyguides on linking and inventing Virtues for a path.
quotes: Fruits are not a manifestation of the Grant Virtue power, they are permanent effects which do not fade when exiting the forest.

entries.title: The Path of Aging
entries.requires: Forest Lore; communion with a genius locus
entries.summary: An example forest path that yields longevity effects, listing its two Sacrifices, Quests and Fruits and including the Immortality of the Forest Virtue that replaces Aging rolls with Warping.
quotes: For each year in which you remain completely within its supernatural aura, you do not make an Aging roll, but instead gain one Warping Point

entries.title: The Path of Energy
entries.requires: Forest Lore; communion with a genius locus
entries.summary: An example forest path for drawing energy from the forest to replenish a magus, with its two Sacrifices, Quests and Fruits.

entries.title: The Path of Warping
entries.requires: Forest Lore; communion with a genius locus
entries.summary: An example forest path built on mastering Warping, including the Twilight Mastery Virtue that lets a magus choose his Twilight effects and inflict Warping, and the Sacrifices, Quests and Fruits of the path.
quotes: once per day you may grant somebody 2 Warping Points
This effect has a Penetration of +5

entries.title: The Path of the Heartbeast
entries.summary: Describes the Bjornaer heartbeast as a forest path overcoming the Limit of Essential Nature, whose price is that the magus can never bind a familiar.
quotes: The sacrifice for this power is the inability to ever bind a familiar.

entries.title: The Arcadian Path
entries.requires: Forest Lore; Mystery of Faerie Magic
entries.summary: A forest path through Arcadia that lets a Merinita-style magus partly overcome the Limit of True Feeling, including the Dispassionate Personality Flaw, the Thief of Emotions Virtue with its Emotion Theft roll, and the path's Sacrifices, Quests and Fruits.
quotes: You cannot have a Personality Trait greater than +1 or less than –1.
You may then make a Presence + Emotion Theft roll against an Ease Factor of 6 + the target's Personality Trait for that emotion.

related.text: ArM5 p.92 Mystery of Faerie Magic
